	for _, path := range []string{".fireweed/eval.sh", ".fireweed/boundary.sh"} {
		body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, path)))
		if !strings.HasPrefix(body, "#!/bin/sh\n") {
			t.Fatalf("fixture hook %s has no shell header", path)
		}
		f.put(path, strings.Replace(body, "#!/bin/sh\n", "#!/bin/sh\n"+logProbe, 1))
	}
}

func assertScratchRemoved(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	common := strings.TrimSpace(f.git("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
		common = filepath.Join(f.root, common)
	}
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
	for _, line := range strings.Split(doctorLog(f), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "setup:") {
			continue
		}
		path := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "setup:")
		for parent := path; ; parent = filepath.Dir(parent) {
			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(parent)
			if err == nil {
				suffix, err := filepath.Rel(parent, path)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				path = filepath.Join(resolved, suffix)
				break
			}
			if parent == filepath.Dir(parent) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, path)
		if err != nil || rel == "." || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			t.Errorf("scratch %q is not below common Git directory %q", path, base)
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Errorf("physical scratch directory %q remains or cannot be checked: %v", path, err)
		}
		return
	}
	t.Error("setup did not record a scratch path")
}

func Test_CHK_049_StaticDiagnosticsStopProbes(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", "---\nname: alpha\nid_prefix: ALP\ndepends_on: []\n---\n## Specs\n### ALP-001\nA.\n### ALP-001\nB.\n")
	f.commit()
	want := project.Check(f.root)
	if len(want) == 0 || !doctorErrors(checks.DoctorReport{Diagnostics: want}) {
		t.Fatal("fixture has no static diagnostic")
	}
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	remaining := map[project.Diagnostic]int{}
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		remaining[d]++
	}
	for _, d := range want {
		if remaining[d] == 0 {
			t.Errorf("complete project diagnostic %+v lost: %s", d, doctorText(report))
		}
		remaining[d]--
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "eval:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "boundaries:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "audit:") {
		t.Errorf("static error ran probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
}

func Test_CHK_050_CHK_051_CHK_052_CHK_053_CHK_055_CHK_056_CHK_057_CHK_058_CHK_059_CHK_060_CHK_061_CHK_067_RealGoRecipe(t *testing.T) {
	f := newDoctorFixture(t)
	f.commit()
	f.bin = doctorBinary(t)
	f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) {
		config["modules"] = []string{"packages/alpha"}
		config["hooks"].(map[string]any)["setup"] = fmt.Sprintf("printf 'setup:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q; test -z \"$(git symbolic-ref -q HEAD)\" && test -f .fireweed/doctor-untracked && go mod download", f.log)
	})
	f.put(".fireweed/doctor-untracked", "ready\n")
	for _, d := range project.Check(f.root) {
		if !d.Warning {
			t.Fatalf("invalid Go doctor fixture: %+v", d)
		}
	}
	beforeStatus, beforeWorktrees := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("real Go recipe doctor failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"baseline", "undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id", "recovery"} {
		if !hasDoctorCheck(report, name, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing passing %s outcome: %s", name, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
	recoveries := 0
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(check.Name), "recovery") && check.Passed {
			recoveries++
		}
	}
	if recoveries < 4 {
		t.Errorf("clean recovery not reported after each canary: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	modules := map[string]bool{}
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if check.Module != "" && check.Module != "alpha" {
			modules[check.Module] = true
		}
	}
	if len(modules) < 2 {
		t.Errorf("two distinct throwaway modules absent: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") || !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "/fireweed/worktrees/") {
		t.Errorf("setup did not run in scratch: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "audit:") {
		t.Errorf("NoAgent ran agents: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if got := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"); got != beforeStatus {
		t.Errorf("caller changed: before %q after %q", beforeStatus, got)
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != beforeWorktrees {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration leaked: before %q after %q", beforeWorktrees, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_053_NestedModuleTemplatesRenderForBothCanaries(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put("go.mod", "module example.test/doctorfixture\n\ngo 1.23\n")
	fields := "{{name}}|{{prefix}}|{{package}}|{{go_module}}|{{module_dir}}|{{other_dir}}\n"
	f.put(".fireweed/templates/module/evals/nested.txt.tmpl", "eval|"+fields)
	f.put(".fireweed/templates/module/internal/nested.txt", "internal|"+fields)
	canaries := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml")))
	f.put(".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", strings.Replace(canaries, "undeclared:\n", "  evals/baseline.txt: \"baseline|"+strings.TrimSpace(fields)+"\"\nundeclared:\n", 1))
	eval := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed/eval.sh")))
	check := fmt.Sprintf(`case "$1" in
  doctor*)
    prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
    other=
    for spec in packages/*/SPEC.md; do
      dir=${spec%%/SPEC.md}
      case "$dir" in packages/alpha|"$2") ;; *) other=$dir ;; esac
    done
    expected="$1|$prefix|$1|example.test/doctorfixture|$2|$other"
    test -n "$other" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/evals/nested.txt")" = "eval|$expected" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/internal/nested.txt")" = "internal|$expected" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/evals/baseline.txt")" = "baseline|$expected" &&
      test ! -e "$2/evals/nested.txt.tmpl" || exit 17
    printf 'rendered:%%s\n' "$1" >> %q
    ;;
esac
`, f.log)
	f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", strings.Replace(eval, "#!/bin/sh\n", "#!/bin/sh\n"+check, 1))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("nested template probes failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"baseline", "undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id", "recovery"} {
		if !hasDoctorCheck(report, name, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing passing %s probe: %s", name, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
	modules := map[string]bool{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(doctorLog(f), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "rendered:") {
			modules[strings.TrimPrefix(line, "rendered:")] = true
		}
	}
	if len(modules) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("expected both throwaway modules to pass nested template checks, got %v: %s", modules, doctorText(report))
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration leaked: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") {
		assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_051_CancellationCleansScratchAndStopsSetupGroup(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
	childFinished := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child-finished")
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'setup:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
sh -c 'sleep 2; printf finished > "$1"' sh %q &
printf ready > %q
wait
`, f.log, childFinished, ready))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
	go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, f.request(true)) }()
	deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
			break
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case report := <-reports:
			t.Fatalf("setup exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("setup never signalled readiness")
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case report := <-reports:
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
			t.Errorf("cancelled setup lacked C14: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancelled doctor did not return promptly")
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("cancelled doctor retained Git registration: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	time.Sleep(2200 * time.Millisecond)
	if _, err := os.Stat(childFinished); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("cancelled setup descendant continued: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_054_MissingTemplatesAndCanaryMaps(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, body, term, input, affected string }{
		{"missing template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "---\nname: [broken\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\n---\n", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"missing baseline", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 1\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "baseline", "undeclared"},
		{"missing internal_eval", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "missing_id:\n  evals/missing.txt: missing\n", "internal_eval", "internal_eval", "internal_eval"},
		{"wrong version", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 2\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed canary", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: [bad\n", "canary", "canaries.yaml", "undeclared"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			if tc.name == "missing baseline" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				start, end := strings.Index(body, "baseline:\n"), strings.Index(body, "undeclared:\n")
				if start < 0 || end <= start {
					t.Fatal("fixture cannot isolate baseline map")
				}
				tc.body = body[:start] + "baseline: {}\n" + body[end:]
			}
			if tc.name == "missing internal_eval" {
				body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)))
				tc.body = strings.Replace(body, "internal_eval:\n  internal/private.txt: \"private\"\n  evals/internal.txt: \"{{module_dir}}\"\n", "", 1)
				if tc.body == body {
					t.Fatal("fixture did not remove internal_eval map")
				}
			}
			if tc.body == "" {
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.root, tc.path)); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			} else {
				f.put(tc.path, tc.body)
			}
			f.commit()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, tc.term) {
				t.Errorf("missing C14: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
			identified := false
			for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message+" "+d.Path), strings.ToLower(tc.input)) {
					identified = true
				}
			}
			if !identified {
				t.Errorf("C14 did not identify %s: %s", tc.input, doctorText(report))
			}
			if hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.affected, true) {
				t.Errorf("invalid recipe passed canary: %s", doctorText(report))
			}
		})
	}
}

		if hasDoctorCheck(report, canary, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing boundary hook counted as %s detection: %s", canary, doctorText(report))
		}
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, canary, "boundar") {
			t.Errorf("missing boundary hook lacked named %s canary failure: %s", canary, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
}

func Test_CHK_055_MissingRequiredHookBesideOverride(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) { delete(config["hooks"].(map[string]any), "boundaries") })
	f.put(".fireweed/override-boundary.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'override-boundaries:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\nexec sh .fireweed/boundary.sh\n", f.log))
	f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", strings.Replace(string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"))), "depends_on: []", "depends_on: []\nhooks:\n  boundaries: sh .fireweed/override-boundary.sh", 1))
	f.put("packages/beta/SPEC.md", "---\nname: beta\nid_prefix: BET\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# Beta\n\n## Specs\n\n### BET-001\nThe fixture MUST pass.\n")
	f.put("packages/beta/internal/live.txt", "disposable implementation\n")
	logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
	f.commit()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "X02", false, "beta", "boundar") {
		t.Errorf("module without its own hook escaped required boundary enforcement: %s", doctorText(report))
	}

	}
}

+func value(m map[string]any,k string) any { if m==nil{return nil};return m[k] }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string);return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string:return x;case []any: a:=[]string{};for _,v:=range x {if s,ok:=v.(string);ok{a=append(a,s)}};return a};return nil }

+func expand(s string, vals map[string]string, shell bool) string { re:=regexp.MustCompile(`\{[a-z_]+\}`);return re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s,func(x string)string{v,ok:=vals[strings.Trim(x,"{}")];if !ok{return x};if shell{return shellQuote(v)};return v}) }
+func command(v any, vals map[string]string) (*exec.Cmd,error) { switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(x,vals,true)),nil;case []any: a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,y:=range x{s,ok:=y.(string);if !ok{return nil,errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,expand(s,vals,false))};if len(a)==0||a[0]=="" {return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command(a[0],a[1:]...),nil;case []string: a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,s:=range x{a[i]=expand(s,vals,false)};if len(a)==0||a[0]==""{return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command(a[0],a[1:]...),nil;default:return nil,fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T",v)} }

+func run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, cmd *exec.Cmd, dir, bin string) runResult {if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute}; c,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel();if len(cmd.Args)>0 {cmd=exec.CommandContext(c,cmd.Path,cmd.Args[1:]...)};cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=append(os.Environ(),"FIREWEED_BIN="+bin);var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout;err:=cmd.Run();r:=runResult{out:out.String(),errout:errout.String(),err:err};if err==nil{return r};if c.Err()!=nil {r.err=c.Err();return r};if e,ok:=err.(*exec.ExitError);ok {r.exit=e.ExitCode();r.err=nil};return r}

func Test_CHK_060_OverridesMustDetectTheirCanaries(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, hook, command, script, canary string
	}{
		{"eval", "eval", "sh .fireweed/override-eval.sh {module} {module_dir} {report}", `#!/bin/sh
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"boundary", "boundaries", "sh .fireweed/override-boundary.sh {module}", "#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n", "internal_eval"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			path := ".fireweed/override-" + tc.name + ".sh"
			f.put(path, tc.script)
			f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", strings.Replace(string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"))), "depends_on: []", "depends_on: []\nhooks:\n  "+tc.hook+": "+tc.command, 1))
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			diagnosed := false
			for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
				message := strings.ToLower(d.Message)
				boundaryHook := tc.name == "boundary" && !strings.Contains(message, "global") &&
					(strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundary hook") ||
						strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundaries hook") ||
						strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundaries override boundary hook") ||
						strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundaries override boundaries hook"))
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(message, tc.canary) &&
					(tc.name == "eval" && strings.Contains(message, "alpha "+tc.hook+" override") || boundaryHook) {
					diagnosed = true
				}
			}
			if !diagnosed {
				t.Errorf("broken %s override missed its %s canary without C14: %s", tc.name, tc.canary, doctorText(r))
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_065_UnsetTimeoutBoundsAuditProbe(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'audit:%%s:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" \"$1\" >> %q\nprintf 'audit-timeout-started\n'\nsleep 210\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'\n", f.log))
	f.commit()
	req := f.request(false)
	req.Timeout = 0

	start := time.Now()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), req)
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	log := doctorLog(f)
	if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || strings.Count(log, "worker:") != 1 || strings.Count(log, "audit:") != 1 {
		t.Errorf("agent probes did not run once with immediate worker reply: %s; log=%s", doctorText(report), log)
	}
	if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "audit.sh", "audit-timeout-started") {
		t.Errorf("long audit probe lacked a C15 timeout with its command and output: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if elapsed < 165*time.Second || elapsed > 200*time.Second {
		t.Errorf("unset audit timeout took %s, want a bound near three minutes", elapsed)
	}
}

func mustRead(t *testing.T, path string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
package evals_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
)

func doctorProbeLog(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture, report checks.DoctorReport, role string, markers ...string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var detail string
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if check.Name == role {
			detail = check.Detail
			break
		}
	}
	if detail == "" {
		t.Errorf("executed %s probe has no check: %s", role, doctorText(report))
		return ""
	}
	at := strings.Index(detail, "log: ")
	if at < 0 {
		t.Errorf("%s detail lacks log path: %q", role, detail)
		return ""
	}
	fields := strings.Fields(detail[at+len("log: "):])
	if len(fields) == 0 {
		t.Errorf("%s detail has empty log path: %q", role, detail)
		return ""
	}
	path := fields[0]
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		t.Errorf("%s log path is not absolute: %q", role, path)
	}
	rel, err := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed", "runs"), path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("%s log path %q: %v", role, path, err)
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(rel), "/")
	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[0] == "." || parts[0] == ".." || parts[1] != "doctor-"+role+"-1.log" {
		t.Errorf("%s log path = %q, want .fireweed/runs/<run>/doctor-%s-1.log", role, path, role)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("read %s log %q: %v", role, path, err)
		return path
	}
	for _, marker := range markers {
		if !strings.Contains(string(data), marker) {
			t.Errorf("%s log lacks %q: %q", role, marker, data)
		}
	}
	return path
}

func doctorLogRun(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture, worker, audit string, report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	t.Helper()
	base := filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed", "runs")
	w, ew := filepath.Rel(base, worker)
	a, ea := filepath.Rel(base, audit)
	if ew != nil || ea != nil {
		t.Errorf("log paths outside run root: %q %q: %v %v", worker, audit, ew, ea)
		return ""
	}
	wRun, aRun := filepath.Dir(w), filepath.Dir(a)
	if wRun != aRun || wRun == "." || wRun == ".." {
		t.Errorf("worker and audit have different run identities: %q %q: %s", worker, audit, doctorText(report))
	}
	return wRun
}

func doctorCallerClean(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture, status, registrations string) {
	t.Helper()
	if got := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"); got != status {
		t.Errorf("caller status changed: before %q after %q", status, got)
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != registrations {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration changed: before %q after %q", registrations, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_081_DoctorProbeLogsShareFreshRunAndPreserveStreams(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker stdout Ω without newline'; printf 'worker stderr β without newline' >&2; printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'audit stdout Ω without newline'; printf 'audit stderr β without newline' >&2; printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n")
	f.commit()
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	var firstRun string
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
		if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
			t.Errorf("successful probes changed outcome: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
		worker := doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "worker stdout Ω without newlineFIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n", "worker stderr β without newline")
		audit := doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "audit stdout Ω without newlineFIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n", "audit stderr β without newline")
		if worker != "" && audit != "" {
			run := doctorLogRun(t, f, worker, audit, report)
			if i == 1 && run == firstRun {
				t.Errorf("consecutive Doctor invocations reused run identity %q", run)
			}
			firstRun = run
		}
		doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_081_DoctorPersistsFailedAndTimedOutProbeOutput(t *testing.T) {
	failureStdout := "early worker stdout Ω\n"
	for i := 1; i <= 25; i++ {
		failureStdout += fmt.Sprintf("later-%02d\n", i)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, role, script, stdout, stderr string
		timeout                            time.Duration
	}{
		{"failure", "worker", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'early worker stdout Ω\\n'; for i in $(seq 1 25); do printf 'later-%02d\\n' \"$i\"; done; printf 'failed worker stderr β' >&2; exit 7\n", failureStdout, "failed worker stderr β", 2 * time.Second},
		{"timeout", "audit", "#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'partial audit stdout Ω'; printf 'partial audit stderr β' >&2; sleep 5\n", "partial audit stdout Ω", "partial audit stderr β", 150 * time.Millisecond},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			if tc.role == "worker" {
				f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", tc.script)
			} else {
				f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", tc.script)
			}
			f.commit()
			status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
			req := f.request(false)
			req.Timeout = tc.timeout
			start := time.Now()
			report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), req)
			if time.Since(start) > 4*time.Second {
				t.Errorf("%s probe did not honor bounded request timeout", tc.name)
			}
			if !hasDoctorCheck(report, tc.role, false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, tc.role, tc.stderr) {
				t.Errorf("%s probe outcome/diagnostic lost: %s", tc.name, doctorText(report))
			}
			path := doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, tc.role, tc.stdout, tc.stderr)
			if tc.name == "failure" && path != "" {
				if !strings.Contains(string(mustRead(t, path)), "later-25") || strings.Contains(doctorText(report), "early worker stdout Ω") {
					t.Errorf("failed probe log or final-20-line diagnostic changed: %s", doctorText(report))
				}
			}
			doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_081_DoctorPersistsCancelledProbeOutput(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "worker-ready")
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'cancel worker stdout Ω'; printf 'cancel worker stderr β' >&2; printf ready > %q; sleep 5\n", ready))
	f.commit()
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
	go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, f.request(false)) }()
	deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
			break
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case report := <-reports:
			t.Fatalf("worker exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("worker never signalled readiness")
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case report := <-reports:
		if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "worker") {
			t.Errorf("cancelled probe outcome lost: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
		doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "cancel worker stdout Ω", "cancel worker stderr β")
	case <-time.After(4 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancelled Doctor did not return promptly")
	}
	doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
}

	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("prompt-file probes failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	log := doctorLog(f)
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(commonDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{
		"worker-prompt:pre" + doctorProbePrompt + "post", "audit-prompt:" + doctorProbePrompt,
		"worker-common:" + common, "audit-common:" + common,
		"worker-literal:literal {unknown}",
		"wrap-prompt:" + doctorProbePrompt, "wrap-common:" + common,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(log, want+"\n") {
			t.Errorf("missing exact argument %q", want)
		}
	}
	workerFile := doctorRecordedPath(t, log, "worker-file")
	auditFile := doctorRecordedPath(t, log, "audit-file")
	if workerFile == auditFile {
		t.Errorf("worker and audit reused prompt file %q", workerFile)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{workerFile, auditFile} {
		if !strings.Contains(log, "wrap-file:"+path+"\n") {
			t.Errorf("wrapper did not receive selected probe file %q", path)
		}
		doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
	}
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
}

func Test_CHK_083_DoctorRemovesPromptFileOnProbeFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"launch", "nonzero", "timeout", "cancel"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
			f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) {
				config["agent"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/agent.sh", "{prompt_file}"}
				if mode == "launch" {
					config["agent"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{filepath.Join(f.root, "missing-agent"), "{prompt_file}"}
					config["agent"].(map[string]any)["wrap"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", "{prompt_file}"}
				}
			})
			f.put(".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker-file:%%s\\n' \"$1\" >> %q\ntest -f \"$1\" || exit 11\nshift\nexec \"$@\"\n", f.log))
			script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker-file:%%s\\nworker-content:%%s\\n' \"$1\" \"$(cat \"$1\")\" >> %q\ntest -f \"$1\" && printf '%%s' %q | cmp -s - \"$1\" || exit 18\nprintf ready > %q\n", f.log, doctorProbePrompt, ready)
			switch mode {
			case "nonzero":
				script += "printf 'failed worker stderr\\n' >&2\nexit 7\n"
			case "timeout", "cancel":
				script += "printf 'waiting worker stdout\\n'\nsleep 5\n"
			}
			f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", script)
			f.commit()
			status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
			req := f.request(false)
			if mode == "timeout" {
				req.Timeout = 2 * time.Second
			}
			ctx := context.Background()
			var cancel context.CancelFunc
			if mode == "cancel" {
				ctx, cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
				defer cancel()
			}
			var report checks.DoctorReport
			if mode == "cancel" {
				reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
				go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, req) }()
				deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
				for {
					if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
						break
					} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					select {
					case report = <-reports:
						t.Fatalf("worker exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
					case <-deadline:
						t.Fatal("worker never signalled readiness")
					case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
					}
				}
				livePath := doctorRecordedPath(t, doctorLog(f), "worker-file")
				if data, err := os.ReadFile(livePath); err != nil || string(data) != doctorProbePrompt {
					t.Errorf("prompt file unavailable before cancellation: %q, %v", data, err)
				}
				cancel()
				select {
				case report = <-reports:
				case <-time.After(4 * time.Second):
					t.Fatal("cancelled Doctor did not return")
				}
			} else {
				report = checks.Doctor(ctx, req)
			}
			if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "worker") {
				t.Errorf("%s probe outcome changed: %s", mode, doctorText(report))
			}
			log := doctorLog(f)
			count := 1
			if mode == "launch" {
				// The shared wrapper records both the failed worker launch and
				// the subsequent audit probe; both files must be cleaned up.
				count = 2
			}
			paths := doctorRecordedPaths(t, log, "worker-file", count)
			if mode != "launch" && !strings.Contains(log, "worker-content:"+doctorProbePrompt+"\n") {
				t.Errorf("%s worker could not read exact prompt: %q", mode, log)
			}
			for _, path := range paths {
				doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
			}
			doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker")
			doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_083_DoctorDoesNotCreatePromptFileWithoutSelectedPlaceholder(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	expected := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "expected-prompt")
	if err := os.WriteFile(expected, []byte(doctorProbePrompt), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	script := fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
while IFS= read -r candidate; do
  if test -f "$candidate" && cmp -s "$candidate" %q; then
    printf 'unexpected prompt file: %%s\n' "$candidate" >&2
    exit 19
  fi
done < <(find "$TMPDIR" "$PWD" -type f -print)
printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'
`, expected)
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", script)
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", script)
	f.commit()
	temp := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("TMPDIR", temp)
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("unneeded prompt file appeared: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
}

func Test_CHK_082_CHK_083_DoctorWrapperOnlyFileWithAuditFallback(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) {
		delete(config["audit"].(map[string]any), "command")
		config["agent"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/agent.sh", "{prompt}"}
		config["agent"].(map[string]any)["wrap"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", "{prompt_file}"}
	})
	f.put(".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
printf 'wrap-file:%%s\n' "$1" >> %q
test -f "$1" && printf '%%s' %q | cmp -s - "$1" || exit 11
shift
exec "$@"
`, f.log, doctorProbePrompt))
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
printf 'fallback-prompt:%%s\n' "$1" >> %q
test "$1" = %q || exit 12
printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'
`, f.log, doctorProbePrompt))
	f.commit()
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", true, "shared") || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("wrapper-only fallback changed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	log := doctorLog(f)
	if strings.Count(log, "fallback-prompt:"+doctorProbePrompt+"\n") != 2 {
		t.Errorf("fallback did not receive fixed prompt twice")
	}
	var paths []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(log, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "wrap-file:") {
			paths = append(paths, strings.TrimPrefix(line, "wrap-file:"))
		}
	}
	if len(paths) != 2 || paths[0] == paths[1] {
		t.Errorf("wrapper prompt files = %q; want distinct worker/audit paths", paths)
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			t.Errorf("wrapper prompt path is relative: %q", path)
		}
		doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
	}
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
}

package evals_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
)

const doctorProbePrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"

func doctorRecordedPath(t *testing.T, log, label string) string {
	t.Helper()
	return doctorRecordedPaths(t, log, label, 1)[0]
}

func doctorRecordedPaths(t *testing.T, log, label string, count int) []string {
	t.Helper()
	var paths []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(log, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, label+":") {
			paths = append(paths, strings.TrimPrefix(line, label+":"))
		}
	}
	if len(paths) != count {
		t.Fatalf("%s paths = %q; want %d absolute paths", label, paths, count)
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			t.Fatalf("%s path = %q; want an absolute path", label, path)
		}
	}
	return paths
}

func doctorPromptFileRemoved(t *testing.T, path string) {
	t.Helper()
	if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("prompt file %q remains after probe: %v", path, err)
	}
}

func structZones() (z contracts.Zones) {

	z.Disposable = []string{"internal/**"}
	return
}

func doctorText(report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("checks=%+v diagnostics=%+v", report.Checks, report.Diagnostics)
}
func hasDoctorDiagnostic(report checks.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, terms ...string) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code != code || d.Warning != warning {
			continue
		}
		ok := true
		for _, s := range terms {
			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), strings.ToLower(s)) {
				ok = false
			}
		}
		if ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func hasDoctorCheck(report checks.DoctorReport, name string, passed bool) bool {
	for _, c := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(c.Name, name) && c.Passed == passed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorErrors(report checks.DoctorReport) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorLog(f doctorFixture) string { b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.log); return string(b) }
func worktrees(f doctorFixture) string { return f.git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain") }

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "encoding/xml"
+ "fmt"
+ "regexp"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitNode struct {XMLName xml.Name `xml:""`; Suites []junitNode `xml:"testsuite"`; Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`}
+type junitCase struct {Name string `xml:"name,attr"`; Class string `xml:"classname,attr"`; Time string `xml:"time,attr"`; Failure []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`; Error []junitProblem `xml:"error"`; Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"`}
+type junitProblem struct {Message string `xml:"message,attr"`; Body string `xml:",chardata"`}
+var idToken=regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:[-_][A-Za-z0-9]+)+`)
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte,specs []contracts.Item)(model.Report,error){var root junitNode;if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)};if root.XMLName.Local!="testsuite"&&root.XMLName.Local!="testsuites"{return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",root.XMLName.Local)};known:=map[string]bool{};for _,s:=range specs{known[s.ID]=true};r:=model.Report{};var walk func(junitNode) error;walk=func(n junitNode)error{for _,c:=range n.Cases{item:=model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Class,Result:"pass"};item.Seconds,_=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);r.Seconds+=item.Seconds;for _,s:=range specs{if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Class){item.IDs=append(item.IDs,s.ID)}};if len(item.IDs)==0 {for _,token:=range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Class,-1){norm:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(token,"_","-"));if known[norm]{continue};if strings.ContainsAny(token,"0123456789") && (strings.Contains(token,"-")||strings.Contains(token,"_")){return coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,token)}};return coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)};if len(c.Failure)>0||len(c.Error)>0{item.Result="fail";for _,p:=range append(c.Failure,c.Error...){for _,v:=range []string{p.Message,p.Body}{v=strings.TrimSpace(v);if v!=""{if item.Failure!=""{item.Failure+="\n"};item.Failure+=v}}}}else if len(c.Skipped)>0{item.Result="skip"};r.Cases=append(r.Cases,item)};for _,s:=range n.Suites{if err:=walk(s);err!=nil{return err}};return nil};if err:=walk(root);err!=nil{return model.Report{},err};return r,nil}
+func hasID(ids []string,id string)bool{for _,x:=range ids{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func RequireCoverage(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,s:=range specs{tag:=strings.ToLower(s.Tag);if strings.HasPrefix(tag,"review")||strings.HasPrefix(tag,"quarantine"){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases{if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c.IDs,s.ID){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(r model.Report,ids,already []string)error{for _,id:=range ids{if hasID(already,id){continue};found:=false;for _,c:=range r.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c.IDs,id){found=true;break}};if !found{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(r model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error{for _,c:=range r.Cases{if c.Result!="fail"{continue};for _,s:=range specs{if hasID(c.IDs,s.ID)&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag),"quarantine"){return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s",c.Name,s.ID)}}};return nil}
+var _=fmt.Sprintf

+package engine
+
+import (

+)
+
+func matches(patterns []string,path string)bool{for _,p:=range patterns{if contracts.MatchGlob(p,path){return true}};return false}
+func gitExists(root,base,path string)bool{if base==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,base,path);return err==nil}
+func Zones(req model.ZoneRequest)[]project.Diagnostic{ds:=[]project.Diagnostic{};var target *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules{if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==req.Module{target=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}};for _,ch:=range req.Changes{paths:=[]string{ch.Path};if ch.OldPath!=""{paths=append(paths,ch.OldPath)};for _,path:=range paths{path=filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path));reason:="";if strings.HasPrefix(path,".fireweed/")||matches(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["protected"]),path){reason="protected path"} else if path==req.ChangePath {if req.Phase!="audit"&&req.Phase!="evals"&&req.Phase!="impl"{reason="invalid phase"}} else if strings.HasPrefix(path,"changes/"){reason="other change file"} else {var owner *project.Module;for i:=range req.Snapshot.Modules{m:=&req.Snapshot.Modules[i];if path==m.Dir||strings.HasPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/"){if owner==nil||len(m.Dir)>len(owner.Dir){owner=m}}};if owner!=nil{if strings.EqualFold(filepath.Base(path),"SPEC.md"){reason="module SPEC.md"}else if target==nil||owner.Name!=target.Name{reason="another module"}else if req.Phase=="audit"{reason="audit only permits current change"}else{rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,owner.Dir+"/");zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,owner.Zones);exists:=gitExists(req.Snapshot.Root,req.Base,path);switch req.Phase{case "evals":switch zone{case "protected","preserve","append_only":reason="forbidden "+zone;case "interface":if !req.InterfaceDeclared{reason="undeclared interface"};case "disposable":if exists{reason="existing disposable file"}};case "impl":switch zone{case "protected","evals","interface":reason="forbidden "+zone;case "append_only":if exists||ch.OldPath!=""||strings.HasPrefix(ch.Status,"D"){reason="existing append_only file"}};default:reason="invalid phase"}}}else if req.Phase=="audit"||!matches(stringsOf(req.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),path){reason="outside writable paths"}};if reason!=""{ds=append(ds,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:path,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s",path,reason)})}}};return ds}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..be77095ba33d99c045ac8ffeb1d0e459a7f5950d

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "regexp"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code string, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { if m,ok:=v.(map[string]any);ok{return m}; return nil }
+func value(m map[string]any,k string) any { if m==nil{return nil};return m[k] }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string);return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string:return x;case []any: a:=[]string{};for _,v:=range x {if s,ok:=v.(string);ok{a=append(a,s)}};return a};return nil }
+func hook(m map[string]any,k string) any {return value(object(value(m,"hooks")),k)}
+func shellQuote(s string) string {return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'"}
+func expand(s string, vals map[string]string, shell bool) string { re:=regexp.MustCompile(`\{[a-z_]+\}`);return re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s,func(x string)string{v,ok:=vals[strings.Trim(x,"{}")];if !ok{return x};if shell{return shellQuote(v)};return v}) }
+func command(v any, vals map[string]string) (*exec.Cmd,error) { switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(x,vals,true)),nil;case []any: a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,y:=range x{s,ok:=y.(string);if !ok{return nil,errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,expand(s,vals,false))};if len(a)==0||a[0]=="" {return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command(a[0],a[1:]...),nil;case []string: a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,s:=range x{a[i]=expand(s,vals,false)};if len(a)==0||a[0]==""{return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command(a[0],a[1:]...),nil;default:return nil,fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T",v)} }
+type runResult struct {out,errout string; exit int; err error}
+func run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, cmd *exec.Cmd, dir, bin string) runResult {if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute}; c,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel();cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=append(os.Environ(),"FIREWEED_BIN="+bin);cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true};var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout;if err:=cmd.Start();err!=nil{return runResult{err:err}};done:=make(chan struct{});go func(){select{case <-c.Done():syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);case <-done:}}();err:=cmd.Wait();close(done);r:=runResult{out:out.String(),errout:errout.String(),err:err};if err==nil{return r};if c.Err()!=nil {r.err=c.Err();return r};if e,ok:=err.(*exec.ExitError);ok {r.exit=e.ExitCode();r.err=nil};return r}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"

+ "encoding/hex"
+ "fmt"
+ "io"

+ "os"
+ "os/exec"

+ "strings"
+ "time"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"

+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const probePrompt="Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+func identity()string{b:=make([]byte,12);rand.Read(b);return hex.EncodeToString(b)}
+func doctorDiag(r *model.DoctorReport,code string,warning bool,msg string){r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Warning:warning,Message:msg})}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport,name,module string,pass bool,detail string){r.Checks=append(r.Checks,model.DoctorCheck{Name:name,Module:module,Passed:pass,Detail:detail})}
+func copyProject(src,dst string)error{return filepath.WalkDir(src,func(p string,d fs.DirEntry,err error)error{if err!=nil{return err};rel,e:=filepath.Rel(src,p);if e!=nil{return e};if rel=="."{return nil};if rel==".git"||strings.HasPrefix(rel,filepath.Join(".fireweed","runs")){if d.IsDir(){return filepath.SkipDir};return nil};target:=filepath.Join(dst,rel);if d.IsDir(){return os.MkdirAll(target,0755)};if !d.Type().IsRegular(){return nil};b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);if e!=nil{return e};if e=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target),0755);e!=nil{return e};info,e:=d.Info();if e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(target,b,info.Mode().Perm())})}
+func guidance(root string,r *model.DoctorReport){const desired="<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->";b,_:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,"AGENTS.md"));if !strings.Contains(string(b),desired){doctorDiag(r,"C16",true,"AGENTS.md managed guidance missing or stale")};files,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","playbooks","*.md"));for _,p:=range files{b,e:=os.ReadFile(p);if e!=nil{continue};doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));base:="";if e==nil{base=str(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"])};name:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p),".md");embedded,e:=assets.Playbook(name);if e!=nil||base==""{doctorDiag(r,"C16",true,"playbook "+name+" embedded_base missing");continue};sum:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded));if base!=hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]){doctorDiag(r,"C16",true,"playbook "+name+" embedded_base stale")}}}
+func setupHook(ctx context.Context,req model.DoctorRequest,snap project.Snapshot,r *model.DoctorReport)bool{h:=hook(snap.Config,"setup");if h==nil{return true};cmd,e:=command(h,map[string]string{});if e!=nil{doctorDiag(r,"C14",false,"setup hook: "+e.Error());return false};res:=run(ctx,req.Timeout,cmd,snap.Root,req.Bin);if res.err!=nil||res.exit!=0{doctorDiag(r,"C14",false,fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v exit %d %s",res.err,res.exit,res.errout));return false};return true}

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "errors"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "os/exec"
+ "regexp"
+ "strings"
+ "syscall"
+ "time"
+)
+
+func coded(code string, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format,args...)) }
+func object(v any) map[string]any { if m,ok:=v.(map[string]any);ok{return m}; return nil }
+func value(m map[string]any,k string) any { if m==nil{return nil};return m[k] }
+func str(v any) string { s,_:=v.(string);return s }
+func stringsOf(v any) []string { switch x:=v.(type) {case []string:return x;case []any: a:=[]string{};for _,v:=range x {if s,ok:=v.(string);ok{a=append(a,s)}};return a};return nil }
+func hook(m map[string]any,k string) any {return value(object(value(m,"hooks")),k)}
+func shellQuote(s string) string {return "'"+strings.ReplaceAll(s,"'","'\\''")+"'"}
+func expand(s string, vals map[string]string, shell bool) string { re:=regexp.MustCompile(`\{[a-z_]+\}`);return re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s,func(x string)string{v,ok:=vals[strings.Trim(x,"{}")];if !ok{return x};if shell{return shellQuote(v)};return v}) }
+func command(v any, vals map[string]string) (*exec.Cmd,error) { switch x:=v.(type) {case string: if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" {return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command("sh","-c",expand(x,vals,true)),nil;case []any: a:=make([]string,0,len(x));for _,y:=range x{s,ok:=y.(string);if !ok{return nil,errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")};a=append(a,expand(s,vals,false))};if len(a)==0||a[0]=="" {return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command(a[0],a[1:]...),nil;case []string: a:=make([]string,len(x));for i,s:=range x{a[i]=expand(s,vals,false)};if len(a)==0||a[0]==""{return nil,errors.New("empty hook command")};return exec.Command(a[0],a[1:]...),nil;default:return nil,fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T",v)} }
+type runResult struct {out,errout string; exit int; err error}
+func run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, cmd *exec.Cmd, dir, bin string) runResult {if timeout<=0 {timeout=3*time.Minute}; c,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout);defer cancel();cmd.Dir=dir;cmd.Env=append(os.Environ(),"FIREWEED_BIN="+bin);cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true};var out,errout strings.Builder;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout;if err:=cmd.Start();err!=nil{return runResult{err:err}};done:=make(chan struct{});go func(){select{case <-c.Done():syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL);case <-done:}}();err:=cmd.Wait();close(done);r:=runResult{out:out.String(),errout:errout.String(),err:err};if err==nil{return r};if c.Err()!=nil {r.err=c.Err();return r};if e,ok:=err.(*exec.ExitError);ok {r.exit=e.ExitCode();r.err=nil};return r}

+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+	"io"
+	"io/fs"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const probePrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+
+func identity() string { b := make([]byte, 12); rand.Read(b); return hex.EncodeToString(b) }
+func doctorDiag(r *model.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, msg string) {
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Warning: warning, Message: msg})
+}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, pass bool, detail string) {
+	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: pass, Detail: detail})
+}
+func copyProject(src, dst string) error {
+	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		rel, e := filepath.Rel(src, p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if rel == "." {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, filepath.Join(".fireweed", "runs")) {
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return filepath.SkipDir
+			}
+			return nil
+		}
+		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
+		}
+		if !d.Type().IsRegular() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		info, e := d.Info()
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		return os.WriteFile(target, b, info.Mode().Perm())
+	})
+}
+func guidance(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	const desired = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->"
+	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
+	if !strings.Contains(string(b), desired) {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C16", true, "AGENTS.md managed guidance missing or stale")
+	}
+	files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "playbooks", "*.md"))
+	for _, p := range files {
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+		base := ""
+		if e == nil {
+			base = str(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"])
+		}
+		name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p), ".md")
+		embedded, e := assets.Playbook(name)
+		if e != nil || base == "" {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C16", true, "playbook "+name+" embedded_base missing")
+			continue
+		}
+		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded))
+		if base != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C16", true, "playbook "+name+" embedded_base stale")
+		}
+	}
+}
+func setupHook(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, r *model.DoctorReport) bool {
+	h := hook(snap.Config, "setup")
+	if h == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	cmd, e := command(h, map[string]string{})
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C14", false, "setup hook: "+e.Error())
+		return false
+	}
+	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
+	if res.err != nil || res.exit != 0 {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C14", false, fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v exit %d %s", res.err, res.exit, res.errout))
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+func loadCanaries(root string) (map[string]map[string]string, error) {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "canaries", "canaries.yaml")
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s: %w", p, e)
+	}
+	var raw struct {
+		Version    int               `yaml:"version"`
+		Baseline   map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
+		Undeclared map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
+		Internal   map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
+		Failing    map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
+		Missing    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
+	}
+	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(b, &raw); e != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s: %w", p, e)
+	}
+	if raw.Version != 1 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s: unsupported version", p)
+	}
+	maps := map[string]map[string]string{"baseline": raw.Baseline, "undeclared": raw.Undeclared, "internal_eval": raw.Internal, "failing_eval": raw.Failing, "missing_id": raw.Missing}
+	for name, m := range maps {
+		if len(m) == 0 {
+			return maps, fmt.Errorf("canary %s missing %s map", p, name)
+		}
+	}
+	return maps, nil
+}
+func renderText(s string, values map[string]string) string {
+	for k, v := range values {
+		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "{{"+k+"}}", v)
+	}
+	return s
+}
+func writeCanaryFiles(root string, files map[string]string, values map[string]string) ([]string, error) {
+	paths := []string{}
+	for rel, body := range files {
+		if rel == "" || filepath.IsAbs(rel) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(rel), "..") {
+			return paths, fmt.Errorf("invalid canary path %q", rel)
+		}
+		p := filepath.Join(root, rel)
+		if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+			return paths, e
+		}
+		if e := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(renderText(body, values)), 0644); e != nil {
+			return paths, e
+		}
+		paths = append(paths, p)
+	}
+	return paths, nil
+}
+func renderModule(root, name, prefix, other, goModule string) (string, error) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, "packages", name)
+	template := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "templates", "module")
+	info, e := os.Stat(template)
+	if e != nil || !info.IsDir() {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template missing: %s", template)
+	}
+	values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("packages", name)), "other_dir": filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("packages", other))}
+	count := 0
+	e = filepath.WalkDir(template, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() {
+			return nil
+		}
+		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(template, p)
+		if strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".tmpl") {
+			rel = strings.TrimSuffix(rel, ".tmpl")
+		}
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		out := filepath.Join(dir, rel)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(out), 0755); e != nil {
+			return e
+		}
+		count++
+		return os.WriteFile(out, []byte(renderText(string(b), values)), 0644)
+	})
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", e)
+	}
+	if count == 0 {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template empty")
+	}
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", e)
+	}
+	if _, e = contracts.ParseDocument(string(b)); e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", e)
+	}
+	return dir, nil
+}
+func boundaryProbe(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any) (string, error) {
+	if h == nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("missing boundaries hook")
+	}
+	cmd, e := command(h, map[string]string{"module": m.Name, "module_dir": m.Dir})
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
+	if res.err != nil {
+		return "", res.err
+	}
+	return res.out + "\n" + res.errout, nil
+}
+func cleanBoundary(text, module string) bool {
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(line) != "" && strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), module+":") {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+func canaryModule(snap project.Snapshot, name string, override map[string]any) project.Module {
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			if override != nil {
+				if m.Document.Frontmatter == nil {
+					m.Document.Frontmatter = map[string]any{}
+				}
+				m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"] = override
+			}
+			return m
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{Name: name, Dir: "packages/" + name}
+}
+func baseline(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, bh any) (string, error) {
+	evalSnap := snap
+	evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	if e != nil {
+		return "eval: " + e.Error(), e
+	}
+	specs, e := moduleSpecs(m)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "eval: " + e.Error(), e
+	}
+	if e = RequireCoverage(rep, specs); e != nil {
+		return "eval coverage: " + e.Error(), e
+	}
+	if e = RequirePass(rep, specs); e != nil {
+		return "eval: " + e.Error(), e
+	}
+	lines, e := boundaryProbe(ctx, req, snap, m, bh)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "boundaries: " + e.Error(), e
+	}
+	if !cleanBoundary(lines, m.Name) {
+		return "boundaries: " + lines, fmt.Errorf("boundary violation")
+	}
+	return "", nil
+}
+func runCanary(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, bh any, name string, files map[string]string, values map[string]string) (bool, string) {
+	paths, e := writeCanaryFiles(filepath.Join(snap.Root, m.Dir), files, values)
+	if e != nil {
+		return false, e.Error()
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		for _, p := range paths {
+			os.Remove(p)
+		}
+	}()
+	switch name {
+	case "undeclared", "internal_eval":
+		lines, e := boundaryProbe(ctx, req, snap, m, bh)
+		if e != nil {
+			return false, "boundaries: " + e.Error()
+		}
+		for _, line := range strings.Split(lines, "\n") {
+			line = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
+			if strings.HasPrefix(line, strings.ToLower(m.Name)+":") && (name != "internal_eval" || strings.Contains(line, "interface")) {
+				return true, lines
+			}
+		}
+		return false, "boundaries missed " + name + ": " + lines
+	case "failing_eval":
+		evalSnap := snap
+		evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+		rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		if e != nil {
+			return false, "eval: " + e.Error()
+		}
+		if rep.HookExit == 0 {
+			return false, "eval: failing_eval exited zero"
+		}
+		for _, c := range rep.Cases {
+			if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c.IDs, m.IDPrefix+"-001") {
+				return true, ""
+			}
+		}
+		return false, "eval: failing_eval lacked referencing failure"
+	case "missing_id":
+		evalSnap := snap
+		evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
+		_, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		if e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "unknown spec ID") && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "UNMAPPED-999") {
+			return true, ""
+		}
+		return false, fmt.Sprintf("eval: missing_id not rejected for unmapped ID: %v", e)
+	}
+	return false, "unknown canary"
+}
+
+func addDoctorModules(root string, names []string) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, "fireweed.yaml")
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	var cfg map[string]any
+	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(b, &cfg); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	v := stringsOf(cfg["modules"])
+	for _, n := range names {
+		v = append(v, "packages/"+n)
+	}
+	cfg["modules"] = v
+	b, e = yaml.Marshal(cfg)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
+}
+func goModule(root string) string {
+	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"))
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
+			return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+func copySourceTemplate(root, name, other, prefix string, maps map[string]map[string]string, gm string) (project.Module, error) {
+	dir, e := renderModule(root, name, prefix, other, gm)
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, e
+	}
+	values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": gm, "module_dir": "packages/" + name, "other_dir": "packages/" + other}
+	if _, e = writeCanaryFiles(dir, maps["baseline"], values); e != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, e
+	}
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "SPEC.md"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", e)
+	}
+	return project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: "packages/" + name, Document: doc}, nil
+}
+func finalLines(s string) string {
+	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(s, "\n"), "\n")
+	if len(lines) > 20 {
+		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
+	}
+	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
+}
+func templateHas(v any, needle string) bool {
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case string:
+		return strings.Contains(x, needle)
+	case []string:
+		for _, s := range x {
+			if strings.Contains(s, needle) {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case []any:
+		for _, s := range x {
+			if strings.Contains(str(s), needle) {
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+func agentProbe(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, common, runID, role string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
+	cfg := snap.Config
+	agent := object(cfg["agent"])
+	audit := object(cfg["audit"])
+	selected := agent["command"]
+	if role == "audit" {
+		if audit["command"] != nil {
+			selected = audit["command"]
+		} else {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", true, "audit shares worker command; shared-command blind spot")
+		}
+	}
+	wrap := agent["wrap"]
+	vals := map[string]string{"prompt": probePrompt, "git_common_dir": common}
+	promptFile := ""
+	if templateHas(selected, "{prompt_file}") || templateHas(wrap, "{prompt_file}") {
+		f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-*")
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" prompt file: "+e.Error())
+			return
+		}
+		promptFile = f.Name()
+		_, e = io.WriteString(f, probePrompt)
+		f.Close()
+		if e != nil {
+			os.Remove(promptFile)
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" prompt file: "+e.Error())
+			return
+		}
+		defer os.Remove(promptFile)
+		vals["prompt_file"] = promptFile
+	}
+	cmd, e := command(selected, vals)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" command: "+e.Error())
+		return
+	}
+	description := strings.Join(cmd.Args, " ")
+	if wrap != nil {
+		w, e := command(wrap, vals)
+		if e != nil {
+			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" wrapper: "+e.Error())
+			return
+		}
+		cmd = exec.Command(w.Path, append(w.Args[1:], cmd.Args...)...)
+	}
+	logPath := filepath.Join(req.Root, ".fireweed", "runs", runID, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
+	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(logPath), 0755)
+	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
+	os.WriteFile(logPath, []byte(res.out+res.errout), 0644)
+	success := res.err == nil && res.exit == 0 && strings.Contains(res.out, "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
+	detail := "command: " + description + " log: " + logPath
+	doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
+	if success {
+		return
+	}
+	tail := finalLines(res.out + res.errout)
+	kind := "command failure"
+	for _, p := range stringsOf(cfg["limit_patterns"]) {
+		if p != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(p)) {
+			kind = "usage limit"
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s: %v exit %d\n%s", role, kind, description, res.err, res.exit, tail))
+}
+func Doctor(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
+	r := model.DoctorReport{Checks: []model.DoctorCheck{}, Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{}}
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(req.Root)...)
+	guidance(req.Root, &r)
+	for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return r
+		}
+	}
+	repo, e := git(req.Root, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch worktree: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	if !filepath.IsAbs(repo) {
+		repo = filepath.Join(req.Root, repo)
+	}
+	common, e := filepath.EvalSymlinks(repo)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch worktree: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	scratch := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees", "doctor-"+identity())
+	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(scratch), 0755)
+	if _, e = git(req.Root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD"); e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch worktree: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	defer func() { git(req.Root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch); os.RemoveAll(scratch) }()
+	if e = copyProject(req.Root, scratch); e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch files: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch project: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	if !setupHook(ctx, req, snap, &r) {
+		return r
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if reason := strings.TrimSpace(str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"])); reason != "" {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "X03", true, m.Name+": "+reason)
+		}
+	}
+	bd, be := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+	for _, d := range bd {
+		if d.Code == "X02" || d.Code == "X04" {
+			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
+		}
+	}
+	_ = be
+	maps, e := loadCanaries(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	names := []string{"doctorone" + identity()[:4], "doctortwo" + identity()[:4]}
+	gm := goModule(scratch)
+	m1, e := copySourceTemplate(scratch, names[0], names[1], "DOC", maps, gm)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "template "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	m2, e := copySourceTemplate(scratch, names[1], names[0], "DOR", maps, gm)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "template "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	if e = addDoctorModules(scratch, names); e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "canary modules: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	snap, e = project.Load(scratch)
+	if e != nil {
+		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "canary project: "+e.Error())
+		return r
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name == names[0] {
+			m1 = m
+		}
+		if m.Name == names[1] {
+			m2 = m
+		}
+	}
+	variants := []struct {
+		m        project.Module
+		label    string
+		eval     any
+		boundary any
+	}{}
+	globalEval := hook(snap.Config, "eval")
+	globalBound := hook(snap.Config, "boundaries")
+	if globalEval != nil || globalBound != nil {
+		variants = append(variants, struct {
+			m        project.Module
+			label    string
+			eval     any
+			boundary any
+		}{m1, "global", globalEval, globalBound})
+	}
+	for _, real := range snap.Modules {
+		if real.Name == names[0] || real.Name == names[1] {
+			continue
+		}
+		eh := hook(real.Document.Frontmatter, "eval")
+		bh := hook(real.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries")
+		if eh == nil && bh == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if eh == nil {
+			eh = globalEval
+		}
+		if bh == nil {
+			bh = globalBound
+		}
+		variants = append(variants, struct {
+			m        project.Module
+			label    string
+			eval     any
+			boundary any
+		}{m2, real.Name + " eval override boundaries override", eh, bh})
+	}
+	if len(variants) == 0 {
+		variants = append(variants, struct {
+			m        project.Module
+			label    string
+			eval     any
+			boundary any
+		}{m1, "global", globalEval, globalBound})
+	}
+	for _, v := range variants {
+		m := v.m
+		if m.Document.Frontmatter == nil {
+			m.Document.Frontmatter = map[string]any{}
+		}
+		m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": v.eval, "boundaries": v.boundary}
+		vals := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": gm, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": "packages/" + names[1]}
+		if m.Name == names[1] {
+			vals["other_dir"] = "packages/" + names[0]
+		}
+		detail, be := baseline(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary)
+		pass := be == nil
+		doctorCheck(&r, "baseline "+v.label, m.Name, pass, detail)
+		if !pass {
+			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "baseline "+v.label+" "+detail)
+			for _, n := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval"} {
+				if v.boundary == nil {
+					doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, n+" "+v.label+" boundaries hook missing")
+				}
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
+			ok, info := runCanary(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary, name, maps[name], vals)
+			doctorCheck(&r, name+" "+v.label, m.Name, ok, info)
+			if !ok {
+				hookName := "eval hook"
+				if name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval" {
+					hookName = "boundaries hook"
+				}
+				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, name+" "+v.label+" "+hookName+": "+info)
+			}
+			recovery, er := baseline(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary)
+			doctorCheck(&r, "recovery "+name+" "+v.label, m.Name, er == nil, recovery)
+			if er != nil {
+				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "recovery "+name+" "+v.label+" hook: "+recovery)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if !req.NoAgent {
+		runID := identity()
+		agentProbe(ctx, req, snap, common, runID, "worker", &r)
+		if ctx.Err() == nil {
+			agentProbe(ctx, req, snap, common, runID, "audit", &r)
+		}
+	}
+	return r
+}

new file mode 100644

+package engine
+
+import (
+ "bytes"

+ "os/exec"

+)
+
+func git(root string,args ...string)(string,error){c:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);b,err:=c.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(b)))};return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)),nil}
+func changesAt(root,rev string)(map[string]string,error){out,err:=git(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",rev,"changes");if err!=nil{return nil,err};m:=map[string]string{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){if !strings.HasSuffix(p,".md")||!strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/"){continue};data,err:=git(root,"show",rev+":"+p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(data);if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("%s at %s: %w",p,rev,err)};m[p]=str(doc.Frontmatter["phase"])};return m,nil}
+func zoneAt(s project.Snapshot,p string)string{for _,m:=range s.Modules{if strings.HasPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/"){return contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(p,m.Dir+"/"),m.Zones)}};return ""}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){r:=model.HistoryReport{};if revisionRange==""{head,e:=git(root,"rev-parse","HEAD");if e!=nil{return r,e};s,e:=project.LoadAt(root,head);if e!=nil{return r,e};base:=str(s.Config["base"]);if base==""{base="main"};ref,e:=git(root,"rev-parse","--verify",base);if e!=nil{return r,e};mb,e:=git(root,"merge-base",head,ref);if e!=nil{return r,e};revisionRange=mb+".."+head};out,err:=git(root,"rev-list","--topo-order","--reverse",revisionRange);if err!=nil{return r,err};if out==""{return r,nil};r.Commits=strings.Split(out,"\n");for _,oid:=range r.Commits{after,err:=project.LoadAt(root,oid);if err!=nil{return r,err};aChanges,err:=changesAt(root,oid);if err!=nil{return r,err};parentsText,err:=git(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",oid);if err!=nil{return r,err};parts:=strings.Fields(parentsText);parents:=parts[1:];if len(parents)==0{parents=[]string{emptyTree(root)}};before,err:=project.LoadAt(root,parents[0]);if err!=nil{return r,err};parentChanges:=make([]map[string]string,len(parents));for i,p:=range parents{parentChanges[i],err=changesAt(root,p);if err!=nil{return r,err}};worker:=false;applied:=false;squashed:=false;target:="";for p,phase:=range aChanges{oldPhase:="";for _,pc:=range parentChanges{if x:=pc[p];x!=""{oldPhase=x};if oldPhase==""{for q,v:=range pc{if path.Base(q)==path.Base(p){oldPhase=v;break}}}}};if phase==""||phase==oldPhase{continue};worker=true;target=p;if phase=="applied"{applied=true;if oldPhase!="impl"{squashed=true;r.Squashed=append(r.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:oid,Change:p})}}};seen:=map[string]bool{};for _,parent:=range parents{diff,err:=git(root,"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,oid);if err!=nil{return r,err};for _,line:=range strings.Split(diff,"\n"){f:=strings.Fields(line);if len(f)<2{continue};status:=f[0];paths:=f[1:];for _,p:=range paths{key:=p+"|"+status;if seen[key]{continue};seen[key]=true;add:=func(code string){r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:p,Message:oid+": "+p})};if (zoneAt(before,p)=="append_only"||zoneAt(after,p)=="append_only")&&status!="A"{add("H03")};if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/archive/")&&status!="A"&&status!="D"{add("H04")};if worker&&!squashed{if matches(stringsOf(before.Config["protected"]),p)||matches(stringsOf(after.Config["protected"]),p)||strings.HasPrefix(p,".fireweed/playbooks/"){add("H01")};if applied&&strings.HasPrefix(p,"packages/")&&(zoneAt(before,p)=="evals"||zoneAt(after,p)=="evals"||zoneAt(before,p)=="interface"||zoneAt(after,p)=="interface"){add("H02")}}}}};_ =target};return r,nil}
+func emptyTree(root string)string{c:=exec.Command("git","-C",root,"hash-object","-t","tree","--stdin");c.Stdin=bytes.NewReader(nil);b,_:=c.Output();return strings.TrimSpace(string(b))}
