package engine

import (
	"encoding/xml"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type junitNode struct {
	XMLName xml.Name    `xml:""`
	Suites  []junitNode `xml:"testsuite"`
	Cases   []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`
}
type junitCase struct {
	Name    string         `xml:"name,attr"`
	Class   string         `xml:"classname,attr"`
	Time    string         `xml:"time,attr"`
	Failure []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`
	Error   []junitProblem `xml:"error"`
	Skipped []struct{}     `xml:"skipped"`
}
type junitProblem struct {
	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
}

var idToken = regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Za-z]+[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)

func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
	var root junitNode
	if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
	}
	if root.XMLName.Local != "testsuite" && root.XMLName.Local != "testsuites" {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", root.XMLName.Local)
	}
	known := map[string]bool{}
	for _, s := range specs {
		known[s.ID] = true
	}
	r := model.Report{}
	var walk func(junitNode) error
	walk = func(n junitNode) error {
		for _, c := range n.Cases {
			item := model.Case{Name: c.Name, Classname: c.Class, Result: "pass"}
			item.Seconds, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time, 64)
			r.Seconds += item.Seconds
			for _, s := range specs {
				if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Class) {
					item.IDs = append(item.IDs, s.ID)
				}
			}
			if len(item.IDs) == 0 {
				for _, token := range idToken.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Class, -1) {
					norm := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(token, "_", "-"))
					if known[norm] {
						continue
					}
					if strings.ContainsAny(token, "0123456789") {
						return coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, token)
					}
				}
				return coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
			}
			if len(c.Failure) > 0 || len(c.Error) > 0 {
				item.Result = "fail"
				for _, p := range append(c.Failure, c.Error...) {
					for _, v := range []string{p.Message, p.Body} {
						v = strings.TrimSpace(v)
						if v != "" {
							if item.Failure != "" {
								item.Failure += "\n"
							}
							item.Failure += v
						}
					}
				}
			} else if len(c.Skipped) > 0 {
				item.Result = "skip"
			}
			r.Cases = append(r.Cases, item)
		}
		for _, s := range n.Suites {
			if err := walk(s); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := walk(root); err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, err
	}
	return r, nil
}
func hasID(ids []string, id string) bool {
	for _, x := range ids {
		if x == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func RequireCoverage(r model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
	for _, s := range specs {
		tag := strings.ToLower(s.Tag)
		if strings.HasPrefix(tag, "review") || strings.HasPrefix(tag, "quarantine") {
			continue
		}
		found := false
		for _, c := range r.Cases {
			if c.Result != "skip" && hasID(c.IDs, s.ID) {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return coded("C10", "no coverage for %s", s.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func RequireFailFirst(r model.Report, ids, already []string) error {
	for _, id := range ids {
		if hasID(already, id) {
			continue
		}
		found := false
		for _, c := range r.Cases {
			if (c.Result == "fail" || c.Result == "error") && hasID(c.IDs, id) {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return coded("P2-01", "no fail-first case for %s", id)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func RequirePass(r model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
	for _, c := range r.Cases {
		if c.Result != "fail" && c.Result != "error" {
			continue
		}
		for _, s := range specs {
			if hasID(c.IDs, s.ID) && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s.Tag), "quarantine") {
				return coded("E01", "failed case %q for %s", c.Name, s.ID)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
package engine

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

const probePrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"

func identity() string { b := make([]byte, 12); rand.Read(b); return hex.EncodeToString(b) }
func doctorDiag(r *model.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, msg string) {
	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Warning: warning, Message: msg})
}
func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, pass bool, detail string) {
	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: pass, Detail: detail})
}
func copyProject(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, e := filepath.Rel(src, p)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if rel == "." {
			return nil
		}
		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, filepath.Join(".fireweed", "runs")) {
			if d.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if d.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
		}
		if !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return nil
		}
		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		info, e := d.Info()
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		return os.WriteFile(target, b, info.Mode().Perm())
	})
}
func guidance(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	const desired = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->"
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
	if !strings.Contains(string(b), desired) {
		doctorDiag(r, "C16", true, "AGENTS.md managed guidance missing or stale")
	}
	files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "playbooks", "*.md"))
	for _, p := range files {
		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
		if e != nil {
			continue
		}
		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
		base := ""
		if e == nil {
			base = str(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"])
		}
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p), ".md")
		embedded, e := assets.Playbook(name)
		if e != nil || base == "" {
			doctorDiag(r, "C16", true, "playbook "+name+" embedded_base missing")
			continue
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded))
		if base != hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) {
			doctorDiag(r, "C16", true, "playbook "+name+" embedded_base stale")
		}
	}
}
func setupHook(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, r *model.DoctorReport) bool {
	h := hook(snap.Config, "setup")
	if h == nil {
		return true
	}
	cmd, e := command(h, map[string]string{})
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(r, "C14", false, "setup hook: "+e.Error())
		return false
	}
	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
	if res.err != nil || res.exit != 0 {
		doctorDiag(r, "C14", false, fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v exit %d %s", res.err, res.exit, res.errout))
		return false
	}
	return true
}
func loadCanaries(root string) (map[string]map[string]string, error) {
	p := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "canaries", "canaries.yaml")
	b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s: %w", p, e)
	}
	var raw struct {
		Version    int               `yaml:"version"`
		Baseline   map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
		Undeclared map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
		Internal   map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
		Failing    map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
		Missing    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
	}
	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(b, &raw); e != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s: %w", p, e)
	}
	if raw.Version != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canary %s: unsupported version", p)
	}
	maps := map[string]map[string]string{"baseline": raw.Baseline, "undeclared": raw.Undeclared, "internal_eval": raw.Internal, "failing_eval": raw.Failing, "missing_id": raw.Missing}
	for name, m := range maps {
		if len(m) == 0 {
			return maps, fmt.Errorf("canary %s missing %s map", p, name)
		}
	}
	return maps, nil
}
func renderText(s string, values map[string]string) string {
	for k, v := range values {
		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "{{"+k+"}}", v)
	}
	return s
}
func writeCanaryFiles(root string, files map[string]string, values map[string]string) ([]string, error) {
	paths := []string{}
	for rel, body := range files {
		if rel == "" || filepath.IsAbs(rel) || strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Clean(rel), "..") {
			return paths, fmt.Errorf("invalid canary path %q", rel)
		}
		p := filepath.Join(root, rel)
		if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
			return paths, e
		}
		if e := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(renderText(body, values)), 0644); e != nil {
			return paths, e
		}
		paths = append(paths, p)
	}
	return paths, nil
}
func renderModule(root, name, prefix, other, goModule string) (string, error) {
	dir := filepath.Join(root, "packages", name)
	template := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "templates", "module")
	info, e := os.Stat(template)
	if e != nil || !info.IsDir() {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template missing: %s", template)
	}
	values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("packages", name)), "other_dir": filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("packages", other))}
	count := 0
	e = filepath.WalkDir(template, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(template, p)
		if strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".tmpl") {
			rel = strings.TrimSuffix(rel, ".tmpl")
		}
		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		out := filepath.Join(dir, rel)
		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(out), 0755); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		count++
		return os.WriteFile(out, []byte(renderText(string(b), values)), 0644)
	})
	if e != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", e)
	}
	if count == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template empty")
	}
	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "SPEC.md"))
	if e != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", e)
	}
	if _, e = contracts.ParseDocument(string(b)); e != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", e)
	}
	return dir, nil
}
func boundaryProbe(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, h any) (string, error) {
	if h == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("missing boundaries hook")
	}
	cmd, e := command(h, map[string]string{"module": m.Name, "module_dir": m.Dir})
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
	if res.err != nil {
		return "", res.err
	}
	return res.out + "\n" + res.errout, nil
}
func cleanBoundary(text, module string) bool {
	for _, line := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(line) != "" && strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), module+":") {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func canaryModule(snap project.Snapshot, name string, override map[string]any) project.Module {
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if m.Name == name {
			if override != nil {
				if m.Document.Frontmatter == nil {
					m.Document.Frontmatter = map[string]any{}
				}
				m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"] = override
			}
			return m
		}
	}
	return project.Module{Name: name, Dir: "packages/" + name}
}
func baseline(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, bh any) (string, error) {
	evalSnap := snap
	evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
	rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
	if e != nil {
		return "eval: " + e.Error(), e
	}
	specs, e := moduleSpecs(m)
	if e != nil {
		return "eval: " + e.Error(), e
	}
	if e = RequireCoverage(rep, specs); e != nil {
		return "eval coverage: " + e.Error(), e
	}
	if e = RequirePass(rep, specs); e != nil {
		return "eval: " + e.Error(), e
	}
	if bh == nil {
		return "", nil
	}
	lines, e := boundaryProbe(ctx, req, snap, m, bh)
	if e != nil {
		return "boundaries: " + e.Error(), e
	}
	if !cleanBoundary(lines, m.Name) {
		return "boundaries: " + lines, fmt.Errorf("boundary violation")
	}
	return "", nil
}
func runCanary(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, m project.Module, bh any, name string, files map[string]string, values map[string]string) (bool, string) {
	paths, e := writeCanaryFiles(filepath.Join(snap.Root, m.Dir), files, values)
	if e != nil {
		return false, e.Error()
	}
	defer func() {
		for _, p := range paths {
			os.Remove(p)
		}
	}()
	switch name {
	case "undeclared", "internal_eval":
		lines, e := boundaryProbe(ctx, req, snap, m, bh)
		if e != nil {
			return false, "boundaries: " + e.Error()
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(lines, "\n") {
			line = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, strings.ToLower(m.Name)+":") && (name != "internal_eval" || strings.Contains(line, "interface")) {
				return true, lines
			}
		}
		return false, "boundaries missed " + name + ": " + lines
	case "failing_eval":
		evalSnap := snap
		evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
		rep, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		if e != nil {
			return false, "eval: " + e.Error()
		}
		if rep.HookExit == 0 {
			return false, "eval: failing_eval exited zero"
		}
		for _, c := range rep.Cases {
			if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c.IDs, m.IDPrefix+"-001") {
				return true, ""
			}
		}
		return false, "eval: failing_eval lacked referencing failure"
	case "missing_id":
		evalSnap := snap
		evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
		_, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		if e != nil && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "unknown spec ID") && strings.Contains(e.Error(), "UNMAPPED-999") {
			return true, ""
		}
		return false, fmt.Sprintf("eval: missing_id not rejected for unmapped ID: %v", e)
	}
	return false, "unknown canary"
}

func addDoctorModules(root string, names []string) error {
	p := filepath.Join(root, "fireweed.yaml")
	b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	var cfg map[string]any
	if e = yaml.Unmarshal(b, &cfg); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	v := stringsOf(cfg["modules"])
	for _, n := range names {
		v = append(v, "packages/"+n)
	}
	cfg["modules"] = v
	b, e = yaml.Marshal(cfg)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return os.WriteFile(p, b, 0644)
}
func goModule(root string) string {
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"))
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "module ") {
			return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "module "))
		}
	}
	return ""
}
func copySourceTemplate(root, name, other, prefix string, maps map[string]map[string]string, gm string) (project.Module, error) {
	dir, e := renderModule(root, name, prefix, other, gm)
	if e != nil {
		return project.Module{}, e
	}
	values := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefix, "package": name, "go_module": gm, "module_dir": "packages/" + name, "other_dir": "packages/" + other}
	if _, e = writeCanaryFiles(dir, maps["baseline"], values); e != nil {
		return project.Module{}, e
	}
	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "SPEC.md"))
	if e != nil {
		return project.Module{}, e
	}
	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
	if e != nil {
		return project.Module{}, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", e)
	}
	return project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: prefix, Dir: "packages/" + name, Document: doc}, nil
}
func finalLines(s string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(s, "\n"), "\n")
	if len(lines) > 20 {
		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
	}
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}
func templateHas(v any, needle string) bool {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		return strings.Contains(x, needle)
	case []string:
		for _, s := range x {
			if strings.Contains(s, needle) {
				return true
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, s := range x {
			if strings.Contains(str(s), needle) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
func agentProbe(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, common, runID, role string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	cfg := snap.Config
	agent := object(cfg["agent"])
	audit := object(cfg["audit"])
	selected := agent["command"]
	if role == "audit" {
		if audit["command"] != nil {
			selected = audit["command"]
		} else {
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", true, "audit shares worker command; shared-command blind spot")
		}
	}
	wrap := agent["wrap"]
	vals := map[string]string{"prompt": probePrompt, "git_common_dir": common}
	promptFile := ""
	if templateHas(selected, "{prompt_file}") || templateHas(wrap, "{prompt_file}") {
		f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-*")
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" prompt file: "+e.Error())
			return
		}
		promptFile = f.Name()
		_, e = io.WriteString(f, probePrompt)
		f.Close()
		if e != nil {
			os.Remove(promptFile)
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" prompt file: "+e.Error())
			return
		}
		defer os.Remove(promptFile)
		vals["prompt_file"] = promptFile
	}
	cmd, e := command(selected, vals)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" command: "+e.Error())
		return
	}
	description := strings.Join(cmd.Args, " ")
	if wrap != nil {
		w, e := command(wrap, vals)
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" wrapper: "+e.Error())
			return
		}
		cmd = exec.Command(w.Path, append(w.Args[1:], cmd.Args...)...)
	}
	logPath := filepath.Join(req.Root, ".fireweed", "runs", runID, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(logPath), 0755)
	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
	os.WriteFile(logPath, []byte(res.out+res.errout), 0644)
	success := res.err == nil && res.exit == 0 && strings.Contains(res.out, "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	detail := "command: " + description + " log: " + logPath
	doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
	if success {
		return
	}
	tail := finalLines(res.out + res.errout)
	kind := "command failure"
	for _, p := range stringsOf(cfg["limit_patterns"]) {
		if p != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(p)) {
			kind = "usage limit"
			break
		}
	}
	doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s: %v exit %d\n%s", role, kind, description, res.err, res.exit, tail))
}
func Doctor(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
	r := model.DoctorReport{Checks: []model.DoctorCheck{}, Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{}}
	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(req.Root)...)
	guidance(req.Root, &r)
	for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return r
		}
	}
	repo, e := git(req.Root, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch worktree: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(repo) {
		repo = filepath.Join(req.Root, repo)
	}
	common, e := filepath.EvalSymlinks(repo)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch worktree: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	scratch := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees", "doctor-"+identity())
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(scratch), 0755)
	if _, e = git(req.Root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", scratch, "HEAD"); e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch worktree: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	defer func() { git(req.Root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch); os.RemoveAll(scratch) }()
	if e = copyProject(req.Root, scratch); e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch files: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	snap, e := project.Load(scratch)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "scratch project: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	if !setupHook(ctx, req, snap, &r) {
		return r
	}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if reason := strings.TrimSpace(str(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"])); reason != "" {
			doctorDiag(&r, "X03", true, m.Name+": "+reason)
		}
	}
	bd, be := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
	for _, d := range bd {
		if d.Code == "X02" || d.Code == "X04" {
			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
		}
	}
	if be != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "baseline boundaries hook: "+be.Error())
		for _, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval"} {
			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, name+" boundaries hook unavailable after baseline failure")
		}
		return r
	}
	maps, e := loadCanaries(scratch)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, e.Error())
		return r
	}
	names := []string{"doctorone" + identity()[:4], "doctortwo" + identity()[:4]}
	gm := goModule(scratch)
	m1, e := copySourceTemplate(scratch, names[0], names[1], "DOC", maps, gm)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "template "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	m2, e := copySourceTemplate(scratch, names[1], names[0], "DOR", maps, gm)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "template "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	if e = addDoctorModules(scratch, names); e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "canary modules: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	snap, e = project.Load(scratch)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "canary project: "+e.Error())
		return r
	}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if m.Name == names[0] {
			m1 = m
		}
		if m.Name == names[1] {
			m2 = m
		}
	}
	variants := []struct {
		m        project.Module
		label    string
		eval     any
		boundary any
	}{}
	globalEval := hook(snap.Config, "eval")
	globalBound := hook(snap.Config, "boundaries")
	if globalEval != nil || globalBound != nil {
		fallbackEval, fallbackBound := globalEval, globalBound
		for _, real := range snap.Modules {
			if fallbackEval == nil {
				fallbackEval = hook(real.Document.Frontmatter, "eval")
			}
			if fallbackBound == nil {
				fallbackBound = hook(real.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries")
			}
		}
		variants = append(variants, struct {
			m        project.Module
			label    string
			eval     any
			boundary any
		}{m1, "global", fallbackEval, fallbackBound})
	}
	for _, real := range snap.Modules {
		if real.Name == names[0] || real.Name == names[1] {
			continue
		}
		eh := hook(real.Document.Frontmatter, "eval")
		bh := hook(real.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries")
		if eh == nil && bh == nil {
			continue
		}
		if eh == nil {
			eh = globalEval
		}
		if bh == nil {
			bh = globalBound
		}
		variants = append(variants, struct {
			m        project.Module
			label    string
			eval     any
			boundary any
		}{m2, real.Name + " eval override boundaries override", eh, bh})
	}
	if len(variants) == 0 {
		variants = append(variants, struct {
			m        project.Module
			label    string
			eval     any
			boundary any
		}{m1, "global", globalEval, globalBound})
	}
	seenCanary := map[string]bool{}
	for _, v := range variants {
		seenCanary[v.m.Name] = true
	}
	if !seenCanary[m1.Name] {
		v := variants[0]
		v.m = m1
		v.label += " second canary"
		variants = append(variants, v)
	}
	if !seenCanary[m2.Name] {
		v := variants[0]
		v.m = m2
		v.label += " second canary"
		variants = append(variants, v)
	}
	for _, v := range variants {
		m := v.m
		if m.Document.Frontmatter == nil {
			m.Document.Frontmatter = map[string]any{}
		}
		m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": v.eval, "boundaries": v.boundary}
		vals := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "go_module": gm, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": "packages/" + names[1]}
		if m.Name == names[1] {
			vals["other_dir"] = "packages/" + names[0]
		}
		detail, be := baseline(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary)
		pass := be == nil
		doctorCheck(&r, "baseline "+v.label, m.Name, pass, detail)
		if !pass {
			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "baseline "+v.label+" "+detail)
			for _, n := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
				hookName := "eval hook"
				if n == "undeclared" || n == "internal_eval" {
					hookName = "boundaries hook"
				}
				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, n+" "+v.label+" "+hookName+" skipped after baseline failure")
			}
			continue
		}
		for _, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {
			if v.boundary == nil && (name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval") {
				continue
			}
			ok, info := runCanary(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary, name, maps[name], vals)
			doctorCheck(&r, name+" "+v.label, m.Name, ok, info)
			if !ok {
				hookName := "eval hook"
				if name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval" {
					hookName = "boundaries hook"
				}
				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, name+" "+v.label+" "+hookName+": "+info)
			}
			recovery, er := baseline(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary)
			doctorCheck(&r, "recovery "+name+" "+v.label, m.Name, er == nil, recovery)
			if er != nil {
				doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "recovery "+name+" "+v.label+" hook: "+recovery)
			}
		}
	}
	if !req.NoAgent {
		runID := identity()
		agentProbe(ctx, req, snap, common, runID, "worker", &r)
		if ctx.Err() == nil {
			agentProbe(ctx, req, snap, common, runID, "audit", &r)
		}
	}
	return r
}

func requireDiagnosticError(t *testing.T, err error, code, cause string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected %s error containing %q", code, cause)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), code+": ") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), cause) || strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(err.Error(), code+": "), code+":") {
		t.Errorf("error = %q; want %s prefix and cause %q", err, code, cause)
	}
}

func checkSpecs() []contracts.Item {
	return []contracts.Item{{ID: "CHK-001"}, {ID: "CHK-002"}, {ID: "CHK-003"}}
}

func Test_CHK_001_CHK_029_CHK_030_NestedJUnitIDsResultsAndTime(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte(`<testsuites><testsuite name="outer"><testsuite name="inner">
<testcase classname="suite.ChK_001" name="passes" time="1.25"/>
<testcase classname="suite" name="test_chk002_failed" time="0.5"><failure message="bad"/></testcase>
<testcase classname="suite" name="test_chk_003_error" time="0.75"><error message="broken"/></testcase>
<testcase classname="CHK-002" name="CHK-001_both" time="0.125"/>
</testsuite></testsuite></testsuites>`)
	report, err := checks.ParseJUnit(data, checkSpecs())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := map[string]checks.Case{
		"passes":             {Name: "passes", Classname: "suite.ChK_001", IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "pass", Seconds: 1.25},
		"test_chk002_failed": {Name: "test_chk002_failed", Classname: "suite", IDs: []string{"CHK-002"}, Result: "fail", Seconds: 0.5},
		"test_chk_003_error": {Name: "test_chk_003_error", Classname: "suite", IDs: []string{"CHK-003"}, Result: "fail", Seconds: 0.75},
		"CHK-001_both":       {Name: "CHK-001_both", Classname: "CHK-002", IDs: []string{"CHK-001", "CHK-002"}, Result: "pass", Seconds: 0.125},
	}
	if len(report.Cases) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("cases = %#v; want %d", report.Cases, len(want))
	}
	for _, got := range report.Cases {
		sort.Strings(got.IDs)
		got.Failure = ""
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want[got.Name]) {
			t.Errorf("case = %#v; want %#v", got, want[got.Name])
		}
	}
}

<testcase name="CHK-003_skip"><skipped/></testcase>
</testsuite>`)
	report, err := checks.ParseJUnit(data, checkSpecs())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := map[string][]string{
		"CHK-001_failure_combined": {"want 2 & got 3", "assertion at example_test.go:17"},
		"CHK-001_failure_message":  {"expected true"},
		"CHK-002_failure_body":     {"actual value was false"},
		"CHK-002_error_combined":   {"panic: nil pointer", "stack at example_test.go:29"},
		"CHK-003_error_message":    {"setup failed"},
		"CHK-003_error_body":       {"missing fixture"},
		"CHK-001_empty_failure":    nil,
		"CHK-002_pass":             nil,
		"CHK-003_skip":             nil,
	}
	if len(report.Cases) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("cases = %#v; want %d", report.Cases, len(want))
	}
	for _, got := range report.Cases {
		parts, ok := want[got.Name]
		if !ok {
			t.Errorf("unexpected case %#v", got)
			continue
		}
		if len(parts) == 0 && got.Failure != "" {
			t.Errorf("%s: failure = %q; want empty", got.Name, got.Failure)
		}
		for _, part := range parts {
			if !strings.Contains(got.Failure, part) {
				t.Errorf("%s: failure = %q; missing %q", got.Name, got.Failure, part)
			}
		}
	}
}

func Test_CHK_002_SkippedJUnitCaseDoesNotCover(t *testing.T) {
	report, err := checks.ParseJUnit([]byte(`<testsuite><testcase name="CHK-001" classname="unit" time="0.125"><skipped/></testcase></testsuite>`), checkSpecs())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	requireDiagnosticError(t, checks.RequireCoverage(report, []contracts.Item{{ID: "CHK-001"}}), "C10", "no coverage for CHK-001")
}

func Test_CHK_027_RejectMalformedXML(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ xml, cause string }{
		{`<testsuite><testcase name="CHK-001"></testsuite>`, "parse JUnit:"},
		{`<document/>`, `invalid JUnit root "document"`},
	} {
		_, err := checks.ParseJUnit([]byte(tc.xml), checkSpecs())
		requireDiagnosticError(t, err, "C11", tc.cause)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_028_RejectMissingAndUnknownIDs(t *testing.T) {
	for _, xml := range []string{
		`<testsuite><testcase name="ordinary" classname="unit"/></testsuite>`,
		`<testsuite><testcase name="ordinary" classname="unit"><skipped/></testcase></testsuite>`,
		`<testsuite><testcase name="CHK-999" classname="unit"/></testsuite>`,
		`<testsuite><testcase name="OCHK001" classname="unit"/></testsuite>`,
		`<testsuite><testcase name="CHK0010" classname="unit"/></testsuite>`,
	} {
		_, err := checks.ParseJUnit([]byte(xml), checkSpecs())
		cause := "has no known spec ID"
		if strings.Contains(xml, "CHK-999") {
			cause = `references unknown spec ID "CHK-999"`
		} else if strings.Contains(xml, "CHK0010") {
			cause = `references unknown spec ID "CHK0010"`
		}
		requireDiagnosticError(t, err, "C11", cause)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_002_CoverageRequiresCurrentNonSkippedCases(t *testing.T) {
	specs := []contracts.Item{{ID: "CHK-001"}, {ID: "CHK-002"}}
	requireDiagnosticError(t, checks.RequireCoverage(checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "pass"}}}, specs), "C10", "no coverage for CHK-002")
	if err := checks.RequireCoverage(checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-001", "CHK-002"}, Result: "fail"}}}, specs); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("failed referencing case should cover both IDs: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_002_CoverageExemptsReviewAndQuarantine(t *testing.T) {
	specs := []contracts.Item{{ID: "CHK-001"}, {ID: "CHK-002", Tag: "review"}, {ID: "CHK-003", Tag: "quarantine: flaky"}}
	if err := checks.RequireCoverage(checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "pass"}}}, specs); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("review/quarantine required coverage: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_025_FailFirstRequiresEachRequestedFailure(t *testing.T) {
	ids := []string{"CHK-001", "CHK-002"}
	bad := []checks.Case{
		{IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "pass"},
		{IDs: []string{"CHK-002"}, Result: "skip"},
		{IDs: []string{"CHK-003"}, Result: "fail"},
	}
	requireDiagnosticError(t, checks.RequireFailFirst(checks.Report{Cases: bad}, ids, nil), "P2-01", "no fail-first case for CHK-001")
	requireDiagnosticError(t, checks.RequireFailFirst(checks.Report{}, ids, nil), "P2-01", "no fail-first case for CHK-001")
	requireDiagnosticError(t, checks.RequireFailFirst(checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "fail"}, {IDs: []string{"CHK-002"}, Result: "skip"}}}, ids, nil), "P2-01", "no fail-first case for CHK-002")
	good := checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "fail"}, {IDs: []string{"CHK-002"}, Result: "fail"}}}
	if err := checks.RequireFailFirst(good, ids, nil); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("both requested IDs failed: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_025_FailFirstAlreadySatisfiedExemption(t *testing.T) {
	report := checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-002"}, Result: "fail"}}}
	if err := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, []string{"CHK-001", "CHK-002"}, []string{"CHK-001"}); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("already_satisfied ID incorrectly required: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_026_PassRejectsNonQuarantinedFailures(t *testing.T) {
	specs := []contracts.Item{{ID: "CHK-001"}, {ID: "CHK-002", Tag: "review"}, {ID: "CHK-003", Tag: "quarantine: flaky"}}
	for _, id := range []string{"CHK-001", "CHK-002"} {
		requireDiagnosticError(t, checks.RequirePass(checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{id}, Result: "fail"}}}, specs), "E01", `failed case "" for `+id)
	}
	if err := checks.RequirePass(checks.Report{Cases: []checks.Case{{IDs: []string{"CHK-003"}, Result: "fail"}}}, specs); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("quarantined failure rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="UNMAPPED-999"/></testsuite>' > "$3"; exit 0; fi

	f.put(".fireweed/boundary.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh

	f.put(".fireweed/wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'wrap:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\nexec \"$@\"\n", f.log))

func structZones() (z contracts.Zones) {
	z.Interface = []string{"api.txt"}
	z.Evals = []string{"evals/**"}
	z.Disposable = []string{"internal/**"}
	return
}

func doctorText(report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("checks=%+v diagnostics=%+v", report.Checks, report.Diagnostics)
}
func hasDoctorDiagnostic(report checks.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, terms ...string) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code != code || d.Warning != warning {
			continue
		}
		ok := true
		for _, s := range terms {
			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), strings.ToLower(s)) {
				ok = false
			}
		}
		if ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func hasDoctorCheck(report checks.DoctorReport, name string, passed bool) bool {
	for _, c := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(c.Name, name) && c.Passed == passed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorErrors(report checks.DoctorReport) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorLog(f doctorFixture) string { b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.log); return string(b) }
func worktrees(f doctorFixture) string { return f.git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain") }

func logDoctorCanaryProbes(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	logProbe := fmt.Sprintf(`printf 'probe:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
for marker in undeclared.txt internal.txt failing.txt missing.txt; do
  if find packages -name "$marker" | grep -q .; then printf 'planted:%%s\n' "$marker" >> %q; fi
done
`, f.log, f.log)
	for _, path := range []string{".fireweed/eval.sh", ".fireweed/boundary.sh"} {
		body := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, path)))
		if !strings.HasPrefix(body, "#!/bin/sh\n") {
			t.Fatalf("fixture hook %s has no shell header", path)
		}
		f.put(path, strings.Replace(body, "#!/bin/sh\n", "#!/bin/sh\n"+logProbe, 1))
	}
}

func assertScratchRemoved(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	common := strings.TrimSpace(f.git("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
		common = filepath.Join(f.root, common)
	}
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
	for _, line := range strings.Split(doctorLog(f), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "setup:") {
			continue
		}
		path := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "setup:")
		for parent := path; ; parent = filepath.Dir(parent) {
			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(parent)
			if err == nil {
				suffix, err := filepath.Rel(parent, path)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				path = filepath.Join(resolved, suffix)
				break
			}
			if parent == filepath.Dir(parent) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, path)
		if err != nil || rel == "." || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			t.Errorf("scratch %q is not below common Git directory %q", path, base)
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Errorf("physical scratch directory %q remains or cannot be checked: %v", path, err)
		}
		return
	}
	t.Error("setup did not record a scratch path")
}

func Test_CHK_049_StaticDiagnosticsStopProbes(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", "---\nname: alpha\nid_prefix: ALP\ndepends_on: []\n---\n## Specs\n### ALP-001\nA.\n### ALP-001\nB.\n")
	f.commit()
	want := project.Check(f.root)
	if len(want) == 0 || !doctorErrors(checks.DoctorReport{Diagnostics: want}) {
		t.Fatal("fixture has no static diagnostic")
	}
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	remaining := map[project.Diagnostic]int{}
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		remaining[d]++
	}
	for _, d := range want {
		if remaining[d] == 0 {
			t.Errorf("complete project diagnostic %+v lost: %s", d, doctorText(report))
		}
		remaining[d]--
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "eval:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "boundaries:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "audit:") {
		t.Errorf("static error ran probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
}

func Test_CHK_050_CHK_051_CHK_052_CHK_053_CHK_055_CHK_056_CHK_057_CHK_058_CHK_059_CHK_060_CHK_061_CHK_067_RealGoRecipe(t *testing.T) {
	f := newDoctorFixture(t)
	f.commit()
	f.bin = doctorBinary(t)
	f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) {
		config["modules"] = []string{"packages/alpha"}
		config["hooks"].(map[string]any)["setup"] = fmt.Sprintf("printf 'setup:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q; test -z \"$(git symbolic-ref -q HEAD)\" && test -f .fireweed/doctor-untracked && go mod download", f.log)
	})
	f.put(".fireweed/doctor-untracked", "ready\n")
	for _, d := range project.Check(f.root) {
		if !d.Warning {
			t.Fatalf("invalid Go doctor fixture: %+v", d)
		}
	}
	beforeStatus, beforeWorktrees := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("real Go recipe doctor failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"baseline", "undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id", "recovery"} {
		if !hasDoctorCheck(report, name, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing passing %s outcome: %s", name, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
	recoveries := 0
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(check.Name), "recovery") && check.Passed {
			recoveries++
		}
	}
	if recoveries < 4 {
		t.Errorf("clean recovery not reported after each canary: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	modules := map[string]bool{}
	for _, check := range report.Checks {
		if check.Module != "" && check.Module != "alpha" {
			modules[check.Module] = true
		}
	}
	if len(modules) < 2 {
		t.Errorf("two distinct throwaway modules absent: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") || !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "/fireweed/worktrees/") {
		t.Errorf("setup did not run in scratch: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "audit:") {
		t.Errorf("NoAgent ran agents: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if got := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"); got != beforeStatus {
		t.Errorf("caller changed: before %q after %q", beforeStatus, got)
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != beforeWorktrees {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration leaked: before %q after %q", beforeWorktrees, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_053_NestedModuleTemplatesRenderForBothCanaries(t *testing.T) {

func templateHas(v any, needle string) bool {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		return strings.Contains(x, needle)
	case []string:
		for _, s := range x {
			if strings.Contains(s, needle) {
				return true
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, s := range x {
			if strings.Contains(str(s), needle) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
func agentProbe(ctx context.Context, req model.DoctorRequest, snap project.Snapshot, common, runID, role string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	cfg := snap.Config
	agent := object(cfg["agent"])
	audit := object(cfg["audit"])
	selected := agent["command"]
	if role == "audit" {
		if audit["command"] != nil {
			selected = audit["command"]
		} else {
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", true, "audit shares worker command; shared-command blind spot")
		}
	}
	wrap := agent["wrap"]
	vals := map[string]string{"prompt": probePrompt, "git_common_dir": common}
	promptFile := ""
	if templateHas(selected, "{prompt_file}") || templateHas(wrap, "{prompt_file}") {
		f, e := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-*")
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" prompt file: "+e.Error())
			return
		}
		promptFile = f.Name()
		_, e = io.WriteString(f, probePrompt)
		f.Close()
		if e != nil {
			os.Remove(promptFile)
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" prompt file: "+e.Error())
			return
		}
		defer os.Remove(promptFile)
		vals["prompt_file"] = promptFile
	}
	cmd, e := command(selected, vals)
	if e != nil {
		doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" command: "+e.Error())
		return
	}
	description := strings.Join(cmd.Args, " ")
	if wrap != nil {
		w, e := command(wrap, vals)
		if e != nil {
			doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, role+" wrapper: "+e.Error())
			return
		}
		cmd = exec.Command(w.Path, append(w.Args[1:], cmd.Args...)...)
	}
	logPath := filepath.Join(req.Root, ".fireweed", "runs", runID, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(logPath), 0755)
	res := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)
	os.WriteFile(logPath, []byte(res.out+res.errout), 0644)
	success := res.err == nil && res.exit == 0 && strings.Contains(res.out, "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	detail := "command: " + description + " log: " + logPath
	doctorCheck(r, role, "", success, detail)
	if success {
		return
	}
	tail := finalLines(res.out + res.errout)
	kind := "command failure"
	for _, p := range stringsOf(cfg["limit_patterns"]) {
		if p != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(p)) {
			kind = "usage limit"
			break
		}
	}
	doctorDiag(r, "C15", false, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s: %v exit %d\n%s", role, kind, description, res.err, res.exit, tail))
}

		return r
	}

		m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"] = map[string]any{"eval": v.eval, "boundaries": v.boundary}

		if m.Name == names[1] {
			vals["other_dir"] = "packages/" + names[0]
		}
		detail, be := baseline(ctx, req, snap, m, v.boundary)
		pass := be == nil

		if !pass {
			doctorDiag(&r, "C14", false, "baseline "+v.label+" "+detail)
			for _, n := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id"} {

				if n == "undeclared" || n == "internal_eval" {

	}

	}{
		{"eval", "eval", "sh .fireweed/override-eval.sh {module} {module_dir} {report}", `#!/bin/sh
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"boundary", "boundaries", "sh .fireweed/override-boundary.sh {module}", "#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n", "internal_eval"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			path := ".fireweed/override-" + tc.name + ".sh"
			f.put(path, tc.script)
			f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", strings.Replace(string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"))), "depends_on: []", "depends_on: []\nhooks:\n  "+tc.hook+": "+tc.command, 1))
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			diagnosed := false
			for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
				message := strings.ToLower(d.Message)
				boundaryHook := tc.name == "boundary" && !strings.Contains(message, "global") &&
					(strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundary hook") ||
						strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundaries hook") ||
						strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundaries override boundary hook") ||
						strings.Contains(message, "alpha boundaries override boundaries hook"))
				if d.Code == "C14" && !d.Warning && strings.Contains(message, tc.canary) &&
					(tc.name == "eval" && strings.Contains(message, "alpha "+tc.hook+" override") || boundaryHook) {
					diagnosed = true
				}
			}
			if !diagnosed {
				t.Errorf("broken %s override missed its %s canary without C14: %s", tc.name, tc.canary, doctorText(r))
			}
		})
	}
}

func requireDiagnosticError(t *testing.T, err error, code, cause string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected %s error containing %q", code, cause)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), code+": ") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), cause) || strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(err.Error(), code+": "), code+":") {
		t.Errorf("error = %q; want %s prefix and cause %q", err, code, cause)
	}
}

func checkSpecs() []contracts.Item {
	return []contracts.Item{{ID: "CHK-001"}, {ID: "CHK-002"}, {ID: "CHK-003"}}
}

func Test_CHK_001_CHK_029_CHK_030_NestedJUnitIDsResultsAndTime(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte(`<testsuites><testsuite name="outer"><testsuite name="inner">
<testcase classname="suite.ChK_001" name="passes" time="1.25"/>
<testcase classname="suite" name="test_chk002_failed" time="0.5"><failure message="bad"/></testcase>
<testcase classname="suite" name="test_chk_003_error" time="0.75"><error message="broken"/></testcase>
<testcase classname="CHK-002" name="CHK-001_both" time="0.125"/>
</testsuite></testsuite></testsuites>`)
	report, err := checks.ParseJUnit(data, checkSpecs())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := map[string]checks.Case{
		"passes":             {Name: "passes", Classname: "suite.ChK_001", IDs: []string{"CHK-001"}, Result: "pass", Seconds: 1.25},
		"test_chk002_failed": {Name: "test_chk002_failed", Classname: "suite", IDs: []string{"CHK-002"}, Result: "fail", Seconds: 0.5},
		"test_chk_003_error": {Name: "test_chk_003_error", Classname: "suite", IDs: []string{"CHK-003"}, Result: "fail", Seconds: 0.75},
		"CHK-001_both":       {Name: "CHK-001_both", Classname: "CHK-002", IDs: []string{"CHK-001", "CHK-002"}, Result: "pass", Seconds: 0.125},
	}
	if len(report.Cases) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("cases = %#v; want %d", report.Cases, len(want))
	}
	for _, got := range report.Cases {
		sort.Strings(got.IDs)
		got.Failure = ""
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want[got.Name]) {
			t.Errorf("case = %#v; want %#v", got, want[got.Name])
		}
	}
}

	}
	if len(report.Cases) != 1 || report.Cases[0].Result != "skip" || report.Cases[0].Seconds != 0.125 || !reflect.DeepEqual(report.Cases[0].IDs, []string{"CHK-001"}) {

func Test_CHK_079_ParseJUnitRetainsFailureAndErrorDetails(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte(`<testsuite>
<testcase name="CHK-001_failure_combined"><failure message="want 2 &amp; got 3">assertion at example_test.go:17</failure></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-001_failure_message"><failure message="expected true"/></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-002_failure_body"><failure>actual value was false</failure></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-002_error_combined"><error message="panic: nil pointer">stack at example_test.go:29</error></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-003_error_message"><error message="setup failed"/></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-003_error_body"><error>missing fixture</error></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-001_empty_failure"><failure/></testcase>
<testcase name="CHK-002_pass"/>
<testcase name="CHK-003_skip"><skipped/></testcase>
</testsuite>`)
	report, err := checks.ParseJUnit(data, checkSpecs())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := map[string][]string{
		"CHK-001_failure_combined": {"want 2 & got 3", "assertion at example_test.go:17"},
		"CHK-001_failure_message":  {"expected true"},
		"CHK-002_failure_body":     {"actual value was false"},
		"CHK-002_error_combined":   {"panic: nil pointer", "stack at example_test.go:29"},
		"CHK-003_error_message":    {"setup failed"},
		"CHK-003_error_body":       {"missing fixture"},
		"CHK-001_empty_failure":    nil,
		"CHK-002_pass":             nil,
		"CHK-003_skip":             nil,
	}
	if len(report.Cases) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("cases = %#v; want %d", report.Cases, len(want))
	}
	for _, got := range report.Cases {
		parts, ok := want[got.Name]
		if !ok {
			t.Errorf("unexpected case %#v", got)
			continue
		}
		if len(parts) == 0 && got.Failure != "" {
			t.Errorf("%s: failure = %q; want empty", got.Name, got.Failure)
		}
		for _, part := range parts {
			if !strings.Contains(got.Failure, part) {
				t.Errorf("%s: failure = %q; missing %q", got.Name, got.Failure, part)
			}
		}
	}
}

	"context"

func moduleSpecs(m project.Module) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
	section, ok := contracts.Section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	items, err := contracts.ParseItems(section)
	if err != nil {
		msg := err.Error()
		if strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate") {
			return nil, coded("C05", "%s", msg)
		}
		return nil, coded("C03", "%s", msg)
	}
	return items, nil
}
func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, req model.HookRequest) (model.Report, error) {
	var m *project.Module
	for i := range req.Snapshot.Modules {
		if req.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name == req.Module {
			m = &req.Snapshot.Modules[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if m == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("U02", "unknown module %q", req.Module)
	}
	specs, err := moduleSpecs(*m)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, err
	}
	h := hook(m.Document.Frontmatter, "eval")
	if h == nil {
		h = hook(req.Snapshot.Config, "eval")
	}
	if h == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "missing eval hook for %s", m.Name)
	}
	file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-junit-*.xml")
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "create JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	path := file.Name()
	file.Close()
	os.Remove(path)
	defer os.Remove(path)
	cmd, err := command(h, map[string]string{"module": m.Name, "module_dir": m.Dir, "report": path})
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "eval hook: %v", err)
	}
	r := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, req.Snapshot.Root, req.Bin)
	report := model.Report{HookExit: r.exit, Stdout: r.out, Stderr: r.errout}
	if r.err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "run hook: %v", r.err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "read JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	parsed, err := ParseJUnit(data, specs)
	if err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	report.Cases = parsed.Cases
	report.Seconds = parsed.Seconds
	failed := false
	for _, c := range report.Cases {
		if c.Result == "fail" {
			failed = true
			break
		}
	}
	if (r.exit == 0) == failed {
		return report, coded("C11", "eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures", r.exit)
	}
	return report, nil
}

		}

		}

		}
		if global == nil && own == nil && len(m.Zones.Disposable) > 0 && reason == "" {
			msg := m.Name + ": missing boundaries hook"
			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: msg, Path: m.Dir})
			if first == nil {
				first = fmt.Errorf("%s", msg)
			}
		} else if global == nil && own == nil {
			missingOptional = true
			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X04", Message: m.Name + ": no boundary enforcement required", Path: m.Dir, Warning: true})
		}
	}
	if !hasHook {
		if first == nil && !missingOptional {
			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X04", Message: "no boundary enforcement required", Warning: true})
		}

		dir     string

	}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if h := hook(m.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries"); h != nil {
			hooks = append(hooks, boundaryHook{command: h, module: m.Name, dir: m.Dir})
		}
	}
	for _, h := range hooks {
		cmd, err := command(h.command, map[string]string{"module": h.module, "module_dir": h.dir})

		}
		r := run(ctx, req.Timeout, cmd, snap.Root, req.Bin)

			continue
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(r.out+"\n"+r.errout, "\n") {
			line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\r")
			if line == "" || baseline[line] {
				continue
			}
			attributed := regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:`).MatchString(line)
			for _, m := range snap.Modules {
				if strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") {
					attributed = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !attributed {

			}
			suppressed := false
			for _, m := range snap.Modules {

					suppressed = true
					break
				}
			}
			if suppressed {
				continue
			}
			ds = append(ds, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X01", Message: line})
			if first == nil {
				first = fmt.Errorf("boundary violation: %s", line)
			}
		}
	}
	return ds, first
}

package engine

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func coded(code string, format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}
func object(v any) map[string]any {
	if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
		return m
	}
	return nil
}
func value(m map[string]any, k string) any {
	if m == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return m[k]
}
func str(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
func stringsOf(v any) []string {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case []string:
		return x
	case []any:
		a := []string{}
		for _, v := range x {
			if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
				a = append(a, s)
			}
		}
		return a
	}
	return nil
}
func hook(m map[string]any, k string) any { return value(object(value(m, "hooks")), k) }
func shellQuote(s string) string          { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\\''") + "'" }
func expand(s string, vals map[string]string, shell bool) string {
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`\{[a-z_]+\}`)
	return re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s, func(x string) string {
		v, ok := vals[strings.Trim(x, "{}")]
		if !ok {
			return x
		}
		if shell {
			return shellQuote(v)
		}
		return v
	})
}
func command(v any, vals map[string]string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		if strings.TrimSpace(x) == "" {
			return nil, errors.New("empty hook command")
		}
		return exec.Command("sh", "-c", expand(x, vals, true)), nil
	case []any:
		a := make([]string, 0, len(x))
		for _, y := range x {
			s, ok := y.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")
			}
			a = append(a, expand(s, vals, false))
		}
		if len(a) == 0 || a[0] == "" {
			return nil, errors.New("empty hook command")
		}
		return exec.Command(a[0], a[1:]...), nil
	case []string:
		a := make([]string, len(x))
		for i, s := range x {
			a[i] = expand(s, vals, false)
		}
		if len(a) == 0 || a[0] == "" {
			return nil, errors.New("empty hook command")
		}
		return exec.Command(a[0], a[1:]...), nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T", v)
	}
}

type runResult struct {
	out, errout string
	exit        int
	err         error
}

func run(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, cmd *exec.Cmd, dir, bin string) runResult {
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 3 * time.Minute
	}
	c, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	cmd.Dir = dir
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "FIREWEED_BIN="+bin)
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	var out, errout strings.Builder
	cmd.Stdout = &out
	cmd.Stderr = &errout
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return runResult{err: err}
	}
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		select {
		case <-c.Done():
			syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
		case <-done:
		}
	}()
	err := cmd.Wait()
	close(done)
	r := runResult{out: out.String(), errout: errout.String(), err: err}
	if err == nil {
		return r
	}
	if c.Err() != nil {
		r.err = c.Err()
		return r
	}
	if e, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
		r.exit = e.ExitCode()
		r.err = nil
	}
	return r
}

package engine

import (
	"encoding/xml"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type junitNode struct {
	XMLName xml.Name    `xml:""`
	Suites  []junitNode `xml:"testsuite"`
	Cases   []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`
}
type junitCase struct {
	Name    string         `xml:"name,attr"`
	Class   string         `xml:"classname,attr"`
	Time    string         `xml:"time,attr"`
	Failure []junitProblem `xml:"failure"`
	Error   []junitProblem `xml:"error"`
	Skipped []struct{}     `xml:"skipped"`
}
type junitProblem struct {
	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
}

// A hyphen makes an ID explicit. Compact IDs are only candidates when they
// start with a prefix used by the current specification set; otherwise names
// such as a generated package name ending in digits are ordinary test names.
var explicitID = regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Za-z]+-[0-9]{3,}`)
var compactID = regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Za-z]+_?[0-9]{3,}`)

func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
	var root junitNode
	if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &root); err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
	}
	if root.XMLName.Local != "testsuite" && root.XMLName.Local != "testsuites" {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", root.XMLName.Local)
	}
	known := map[string]bool{}
	prefixes := map[string]bool{}
	for _, s := range specs {
		known[s.ID] = true
		if i := strings.IndexByte(s.ID, '-'); i > 0 {
			prefixes[strings.ToUpper(s.ID[:i])] = true
		}
	}
	r := model.Report{}
	var walk func(junitNode) error
	walk = func(n junitNode) error {
		for _, c := range n.Cases {
			item := model.Case{Name: c.Name, Classname: c.Class, Result: "pass"}
			item.Seconds, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time, 64)
			r.Seconds += item.Seconds
			for _, s := range specs {
				if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Class) {
					item.IDs = append(item.IDs, s.ID)
				}
			}
			if len(item.IDs) == 0 {
				identity := c.Name + " " + c.Class
				candidates := explicitID.FindAllString(identity, -1)
				for _, token := range compactID.FindAllString(identity, -1) {
					upper := strings.ToUpper(token)
					for prefix := range prefixes {
						if strings.HasPrefix(upper, prefix) {
							candidates = append(candidates, token)
							break
						}
					}
				}
				for _, token := range candidates {
					norm := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(token, "_", "-"))
					if known[norm] {
						continue
					}
					return coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, token)
				}
				return coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
			}
			if len(c.Failure) > 0 || len(c.Error) > 0 {
				item.Result = "fail"
				for _, p := range append(c.Failure, c.Error...) {
					for _, v := range []string{p.Message, p.Body} {
						v = strings.TrimSpace(v)
						if v != "" {
							if item.Failure != "" {
								item.Failure += "\n"
							}
							item.Failure += v
						}
					}
				}
			} else if len(c.Skipped) > 0 {
				item.Result = "skip"
			}
			r.Cases = append(r.Cases, item)
		}
		for _, s := range n.Suites {
			if err := walk(s); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	if err := walk(root); err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, err
	}
		}
		for _, c := range rep.Cases {
			if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c.IDs, m.IDPrefix+"-001") {

		return false, "eval: failing_eval lacked referencing failure"
	case "missing_id":

		evalSnap.Modules = []project.Module{m}
		_, e := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: evalSnap, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})

			return true, ""
		}
		return false, fmt.Sprintf("eval: missing_id not rejected for unmapped ID: %v", e)
	}
	return false, "unknown canary"
}

	walk = func(n junitNode) error {
		for _, c := range n.Cases {
			item := model.Case{Name: c.Name, Classname: c.Class, Result: "pass"}
			item.Seconds, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time, 64)
			r.Seconds += item.Seconds
			for _, s := range specs {
				if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Class) {
					item.IDs = append(item.IDs, s.ID)
				}
			}
			if len(item.IDs) == 0 {
				identity := c.Name + " " + c.Class
				candidates := explicitID.FindAllString(identity, -1)
				for _, token := range compactID.FindAllString(identity, -1) {
					upper := strings.ToUpper(token)
					for prefix := range prefixes {
						if !strings.HasPrefix(upper, prefix) {
							continue
						}
						remainder := strings.TrimPrefix(upper, prefix)
						if strings.HasPrefix(remainder, "_") {
							remainder = remainder[1:]
						}
						if remainder != "" && remainder[0] >= '0' && remainder[0] <= '9' {
							candidates = append(candidates, token)
							break
						}
					}
				}
				for _, token := range candidates {
					norm := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(token, "_", "-"))
					if known[norm] {
						continue
					}
					return coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, token)
				}
				return coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)

var canaryTestName = regexp.MustCompile(`Test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+`)

func missingIDDetected(err error, files map[string]string, values map[string]string) bool {
	if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "C11: testcase ") {
		return false
	}
	message := err.Error()
	if !strings.Contains(message, "references unknown spec ID") && !strings.Contains(message, "has no known spec ID") {
		return false
	}
	for _, body := range files {
		body = renderText(body, values)
		for _, pattern := range []*regexp.Regexp{explicitID, canaryTestName} {
			for _, token := range pattern.FindAllString(body, -1) {
				if strings.Contains(message, strconv.Quote(token)) {
					return true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
